PRIMOF.CO.longBusinessSummary: Prime Office A/S operates as a real estate company. It primarily invests in centrally located office buildings in Germany. Prime Office A/S is based in Aarhus, Denmark.

ALCAF.PA.longName: Centrale d'Achat Française pour l'Outre-Mer Société Anonyme
ALCAF.PA.longBusinessSummary: Centrale d'Achat Française pour l'Outre-Mer Société Anonyme engages in the provision of home furnishing products in Europe and Asia. The company offers household appliance products and services under DARTY; home equipment under BUT; design manufacturing under Habitat; natural and wellness products under the Nature & Discoveries; furniture, decoration, and appliances under BUT Cosy; and musical instruments under the Music & Sound brands in Guadeloupe, French Guiana, Martinique, Saint-Martin, Reunion Island, and New Caledonia. It also operates Vente-Unique.com and DirectLowCost.com. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Paris, France.

NEA.MC.longBusinessSummary: Nicolás Correa, S.A. engages in the manufacture ang sale of milling machines and machining centers in Spain, Europe, and internationally. The company offers bed type, travelling column, bridge type, moving table, gantry type, and top gantry milling machines; bed type, travelling column, bridge type, and gantry multitasking machines; express delivery machines; and milling head products. It also provides applications engineering and after-sales services. The company's products are used in aeronautics, automotive, railway, wind energy, capital goods, energy, defense, general machining, and oil and gas applications. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Burgos, Spain.

HIK.MI.longBusinessSummary: Haiki+ S.p.a engages in the treatment, management, and valorization of waste in Italy. It operates waste management plants. The company also offers disposal of non-hazardous waste; and collection, treatment and recovery of waste from electrical and electronic equipment. In addition, it is involved in management of end-of-life products, such as end-of-life tires, photovoltaic modules, batteries and accumulators, as well as environmental consultancy; provision of training courses for sustainable development; production of lead and lead alloys; recovery, recycling, refining, and smelting of lead waste; and recovery and recycling of plastics for the production of polymeric compounds for various industrial sectors. The company is headquartered in Milan, Italy.

EXE.PA.longBusinessSummary: EXEL Industries SA engages in the manufacture and sale of agricultural spraying equipment in France and internationally. The company offers industrial spraying products under the Sames brand; technical hoses under the Tricoflex brand; garden products, such as watering and micro-irrigation, natural gardening, weeding, garden spraying, leisure, and hand-held garden tools under the Hozelock, Berthoud, G.F., Cooper Pegler, Laser Industrie, and Duchesnay brands; and ocean-going sailboats, powerboats, and daysailers under the Wauquiez, Rhéa Marine, and Tofinou brands. It also sells trailed, mounted, and self-propelled agricultural sprayers under the Berthoud, Tecnoma, Nicolas, CMC, Hardi, Evrard, Matrot, Agrifac, Apache, and Exxact Robotics brands; and sugar beet harvesters, diggers, and multi-purpose trucks under the Holmer and CAPAGRI brand. The company serves crops, viticulture, arboriculture, agriculture, construction and earthworks, automotive, energy, industry, transport, wood, harvesting of sugar beets and other roots, spreading, water transfer, food products and cleaning, drinking water, agricultural spraying, paints, compressed air, firefighting, vacuuming, public, and boating sectors. EXEL Industries SA was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

PQ.MI.longBusinessSummary: Piquadro S.p.A. designs, produces, and markets leather goods and accessories in Italy, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Piquadro; The Bridge; and Lancel segments. It offers office bags and backpacks, men's business backpacks, laptop backpacks, business bags, business belt bags, men's office bags, leather briefcase, men's cross body bags, bum bags, mono sling bags, and outdoor backpacks. The company also provides wallets, card holders, document holders, men's leather belts, umbrellas, scarves, hats, office accessories, key rings wristlets, phone covers, wireless charges, power banks, and gift cards. In addition, it provides travel products, including duffle and garment bags, travel backpacks and accessories, cabin and checked luggages, and pilot cases; sneakers and jackets; and special women's products, consisting of shoulder, cross-body, and tote bags, purses, wallets, and keychains, as wells as customize and gift ideas products. It sells its products through its brand stores, e-commerce, multi-brand and single brand shops, and department stores. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Bologna, Italy. Piquadro S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of Piquadro Holding S.p.A.

EXEL.HE.longBusinessSummary: Exel Composites Oyj, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells pultruded composite profiles and tubes in Europe, North America, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It offers bus and coach, train and tram, truck and trailer, and automotive profiles; window and door and standard structural composite profiles, as well as sunshades, umbrellas, and awnings; wind turbines composites; 4G performance and dynamic, 5G macro and MIMO, and 5G small cell mmWave composites; and composites for frangible support structures, water and wastewater, utility power transmission and distribution, and rail solutions. The company also provides camouflage netting support and carbon fiber telescoping poles, as well as non-magnetic tool handles; composites for paper machines, composite conduit rods, textile machine solutions, and insulating and non-ferrous composite solutions; and composite tubes, telescoping poles, and tool handles. Its products are used in the transportation, buildings, wind power, telecommunication, infrastructure, defense, machinery and electrical, equipment, agriculture, sporting goods, oil and gas, and photography industries. The company was formerly known as Exel Oyj and changed its name to Exel Composites Oyj in April 2009. Exel Composites Oyj was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Vantaa, Finland.

MARE.MI.longBusinessSummary: Mare Group S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides digital engineering services in Italy and internationally. It offers engineering and digitalization services in the engineering, civil, and critical infrastructure sectors; and development of projects related to digitalization, automation, and applications of enabling technologies in the transport and industrial engineering sectors. The company was formerly known as Mare Engineering S.r.l. and changed its name to Mare Group S.p.A. in May 2022. Mare Group S.p.A. was founded in 2001 and is based in Pomigliano d'Arco, Italy.

ECNL.MI.longBusinessSummary: Aquafil S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, reprocessing, and sale of yarns in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the United States, Asia, and Oceania. The company offers bulk continuous filament for textile floor covering, such as polyamide 6-based yarn, partly petroleum-based, and partly from regenerated ECONYL; nylon textile filament fibers for textile and clothing use, including polyamide 6 and 66 fibers, and Dryarn polypropylene microfibers for men's and women's hosiery, as well as knitwear and non-run fabrics for underwear, sportswear, and special technical applications; and polymers and polyamide 6 for engineering plastics and injection molding. It is also involved in industrial chemical plant design and supply. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Arco, Italy. Aquafil S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of Aquafin Holding S.p.A.

ALTPC.PA.longName: Société Marseillaise du Tunnel Prado Carénage
ALTPC.PA.longBusinessSummary: Société Marseillaise du Tunnel Prado Carénage constructs and operates tunnels in France. It operates tunnels, including the Prado Carénage, Prado Sud, Louis Rège, and Schloesing tunnels. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Marseille, France.

SBC.MI.longBusinessSummary: Sicily by Car S.p.A. engages in the car rental business in Italy. The company offers driverless, commercial vehicles, and medium-long-term rental services under Sicily by Car brand. Sicily by Car S.p.A. was founded in 1963 and is based in Bolzano, Italy. Sicily by Car S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of Dragotto Holding Spa.

SSL.MI.longBusinessSummary: S.S. Lazio S.p.A. is involved in the technical-sporting activities in Italy. The company also engages in the management of broadcasting rights relating to football team, as well as advertising, merchandising, and general commercial exploitation activities. S.S. Lazio S.p.A. was founded in 1900 and is headquartered in Formello, Italy.

PYR.DE.longBusinessSummary: Pyrum Innovations AG provides patented thermolysis technology in the recycling market for used tires and plastics worldwide. The company recycles used tires and produces secondary raw materials, such as rubber granules, thermolyzed carbon milled, recovered carbon black, thermolysis oils, and steel wires. It also offers laboratory systems, semi-industrial and industrial plants, and thermolysis of bicycle tires solutions; and waste tire disposal, green workshops, and laboratory testing services. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Dillingen, Germany.

GFGT.VI.longBusinessSummary: Global Fashion Group S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates e-commerce platforms for fashion and lifestyle markets in Latin America, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand. It offers products for various fashion and lifestyle categories, such as apparel, footwear, accessories, beauty, and sportswear. The company leases various offices, warehouses, equipment, and vehicles; trustee, consultancy, finance, and IT services; and online retail services, as well as operates as a general partner. It operates through three e-commerce platforms, which include Dafiti, ZALORA, and THE ICONIC. The company was formerly known as Global Fashion Holding S.A. and changed its name to Global Fashion Group S.A. in March 2015. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Senningerberg, Luxembourg.

ALNSE.PA.longBusinessSummary: NSE S.A. designs, produces, and sells integrated systems for civil and military in France and internationally. The company offers design and integration electronic equipment; design, prototyping, testing and qualification, pre-series and series production services to produce on-board electrical and electronic equipment, cords, bundles or complex harnesses; and design and integration of on-board systems and complex wired structures, such as radars, servo systems, control and power control bays, and computer boxes. It also provides logistical and technical support services; maintenance repair overhaul for civil and military aircraft; and customer interface, repair, transport management, and supply chain. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Nizerolles, France. NSE S.A. operates as a subsidiary of NSE Participations.

VLS.MI.longBusinessSummary: Valsoia S.p.A. provides plant-based and healthy food products in Italy and internationally. The company offers a variety of products under its own brands, including Valsoia Bontà e Salute, which covers a wide range of plant-based foods such as ice creams, oat and almond drinks, creams, hazelnut spreads, mayonnaise, and cooking creams; Naturattiva, which provides organic soy and rice-based specialties; and Vitasoya, which offers soy drinks. It sells its products under Pomodorissimo, Weetabix, Diete-tic, Piadina Loriana. The company also owns the Santa Rosa brand for jams, Diete. Tic for liquid sweeteners, and Loriana for piadina flatbreads. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Bologna, Italy. Valsoia S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of Finsalute S.R.L.

CITYVA.HE.longBusinessSummary: Cityvarasto Oyj operates as a self-storage, van rental and moving service company in Finland. The company engages in owning, leasing, developing, and trading warehouses, commercial premises, workspaces, recreational and production facilities, residential properties, containers, land areas, and properties, as well as securities trading. It also rents self-storage, mesh, locker, and drive-up units, as well as storage containers and mailboxes; sells storage, packing, and protective products, such as cardboard boxes, packing materials, locks, moving boxes, moving blankets, protective covers, and moving kits; and offers customers reception services. In addition, the company is involved in short-term rental of vans and moving service business. Cityvarasto Oyj was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Vantaa, Finland.

YADR.MC.longBusinessSummary: Adriano Care SOCIMI, S.A. invests in real estate assets related with the elderly. It focuses its investments in senior housing, residential adapted to elderly needs, and other care centres for the elderly. The company is based in Madrid, Spain.

FFARMS.CO.longBusinessSummary: FirstFarms A/S, through its subsidiaries, engages in the agriculture and food products businesses in Denmark, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, and Romania. The company is involved in milk production and pig production; and development of land portfolio. It also produces crops, such as wheat, rapeseed, grass, sunflower, rye, sugar beet, sorghum, soybean, barley, maize, poppy, and peas. FirstFarms A/S was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Billund, Denmark.

NYXH.BR.longBusinessSummary: Nyxoah SA, a medical technology company, focuses on the development and commercialization of solutions to treat obstructive sleep apnea. Its lead solution is the Genio system, a hypoglossal neurostimulations therapy for obstructive sleep apnea. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium.

SRP.PA.longBusinessSummary: SRP Groupe S.A. engages in the e-commerce business in France and internationally. The company operates Showroomprive.com, an online sales event site specialized in fashion; Beautéprivée, an online beauty sales event site; Saldiprivati, a fashion site specializing in sales events; and The Bradery, a fashion site specializing in sales events. It also offers data and advertising services; produces optimized content for e-commerce and web communication; operates a marketplace to assist retailers who want to sell their products directly; and supports brands in promoting and enhancing their CSR commitments. In addition, the company offers fashion items, including ready-to-wear clothing, fashion accessories, children's clothing, shoes, and underwear; beauty and care products, such as makeup, cosmetics, hair care, and styling products; home and garden products comprising sheets, dishes, light fixtures, and rugs; small electronic devices and other household appliances, including power tools, sewing machines, vacuum cleaners, and small electronic devices and other household appliances; travel and entertainment packages; bedding and other furniture; and other products, such as sporting goods, toys and childcare items, food and drinks, ticketing, etc. SRP Groupe S.A. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Saint-Denis, France.

ED4.DE.longBusinessSummary: EDAG Engineering Group AG engages in the development of vehicles, derivatives, modules, and production facilities for the automotive and commercial vehicle industries worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Vehicle Engineering, Electrics/Electronics, and Production Solutions segments. The Vehicle Engineering segment offers vehicle development services, including package and ergonomics, body assembly, surface design, and interior and exterior development services; vehicle integration services; test vehicles, sub-assemblies, vehicle bodies, and individual vehicle conversions; hydrogen storage systems; project management; and after sales services. Its Electrics/Electronics segment is involved in the development of electrical and electronic systems and functions; integration and validation; development of hardware and software components; and process and data management. The Production Solutions segment engages in automotive solutions comprising planning and virtual commissioning; industrial solutions, such as the development of production solutions; and smart city solutions. It serves automotive and bikes, commercial and off-road-vehicles, defense, medical and pharma, energy, and industrial sectors. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Arbon, Switzerland. EDAG Engineering Group AG operates as a subsidiary of Aton Austria Holding GmbH.

ALBON.PA.longBusinessSummary: Compagnie Lebon engages in the capital and real estate investment, asset management, hotel business, hydrotherapy, and heritage activities in France. The company is involved in the private equity business, which includes the acquisition of the majority and minority stakes in the capital of unlisted small and medium-sized companies; structuring and management of real estate club deals; and real estate valuation services. It also engages in the acquisition, renovation, management, and operation of boutique hotels; management of shops; leasing of office buildings; operation of parking spaces; investment management; direct investments in SMEs; real estate development and restructuring; and operation of thermal baths and spas under the Brides-les-Bains, Salins-les-Thermes, and Allevard names. The company was founded in 1835 and is headquartered in Paris, France. Compagnie Lebon operates as a subsidiary of France Participations SA.

ALRIS.PA.longBusinessSummary: Rising Stone S.A. operates as a developer and builder of luxury and ultra-luxury real estate property in France. It also offers luxury real estate services. The company was formerly known as JTO Management. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Paris, France.

BYTE.MC.longBusinessSummary: ByteTravel, S.A. provides digital solutions for tourists and business travelers in Spain, the European Union, and internationally. The company offers Visagov, which processes tourist and business visas online; Roamic, an international e-sim; Globely, a travel insurance service; and PrioVip, which provides users with exclusive access to VIP lounges through the SalasVip.com platform. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Esta Travel Services, S.L. and changed its name to ByteTravel, S.A. in June 2024. ByteTravel, S.A. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Sant Cugat del Vallès, Spain.

ALCLS.PA.longBusinessSummary: Cellectis S.A., a clinical stage biotechnological company, develops products based on gene-editing with a portfolio of allogeneic chimeric antigen receptor T-cells product candidates in the field of immuno-oncology and gene therapy product candidates in other therapeutic indications. The company is developing BALLI-01, to evaluate the safety, expansion, persistence, and clinical activities of lasme-cel in patients with r/r ALL; NatHaLi-01, designed to evaluate the safety, expansion, persistence, and clinical activity of eti-cel in patients with relapsed or refractory B-Cell Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma (B-NHL). It also develops ALPHA3, targets Large B-Cell Lymphoma (LBCL); TRAVERSE, for the treatment of patients with advanced or metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma (RCC). In addition, the company Melanoma, for treatment of unresectable or metastatic melanoma. Cellectis S.A. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

GLINT.LS.longBusinessSummary: Glintt Global, S.A. provides supporting solutions and services in life-centered industries that enable digital transformation Portugal and Spain. It operates through two segments, Health and Other Markets. The company engages in the sale of equipment, furniture, consumables, and robotics solutions; development of architectural projects; and design and conception of lay-out and image for pharmacies, training, equipment maintenance, and consultancy projects. It licenses proprietary software solutions for healthcare providers, such as clinics, hospitals, pharmacies, and other bodies of the ministry of health; and develops, implements, and maintains software services for the health sector. In addition, the company implements ERPs, system integration themes, and develops tailored applications services. Further, the company develops, implements, and integrates partner platforms with emphasis on the BPM, ERP, BI and mobility solutions; and integrates IT infrastructures, as well as support for networking, security, systems storage, and database management. The company was formerly known as Glintt - Global Intelligent Technologies, S.A. and changed its name to Glintt Global, S.A. in July 2024. Glintt Global, S.A. was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Sintra, Portugal. Glintt Global, S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Farminveste - Investimentos, Participações E Gestão S.A.

HYL.BR.longBusinessSummary: Hyloris Pharmaceuticals SA operates as a specialty pharmaceutical company in Belgium, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific. The company offers Maxigesic IV for the treatment of post-operative pain; Podofilox gel, a topical antimycotic drug for external genital and perianal warts; Sotalol IV, an intravenous formulation of sotalol for the treatment of atrial fibrillation, and life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias; and Valacyclovir oral suspension for the treatment of herpes virus infections. It also provides Atomoxetine oral liquid for the treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder; XTRAZA and Tranexamic Acid IV RTU for the prevention and treatment of excessive bleeding; HY-094 Iron IV to treat iron deficiency; and Pantoprazole IV for short-term treatment of adult patients with gastroesophageal reflux disease and a history of erosive esophagitis. In addition, the company is involved in the development of Alenura for painful bladder syndrome; Phosphate oral liquid for phosphate supplementation; and HY-095 PPI for the treatment of gastric ulcers in horses. Further, it develops Aspirin IV for acute coronary syndrome indication; Milrinone for late-stage HF with LVAD; Dofetilide IV for atrial fibrillation indication; HY-074 for acute coronary syndrome indication; Metolazone IV for congestive heart failure indication; and HY-75 for coronary heart disease indication. The company has collaboration agreements with FHP BV, Pleco Therapeutics, Vaneltix Pharma, Inc., and AFT Pharmaceuticals. Hyloris Pharmaceuticals SA was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Liège, Belgium.

LQAG.DE.longBusinessSummary: Laiqon AG develops, arranges, initiates, and markets investment products for private and institutional investors in Germany. The company operates through LAIQON Asset Management; LAIQON Wealth Management; LAIQON Digital Wealth; and LAIQON Group segments. It provides managed equity, bond, mixed, and single hedge funds; and manages and supervises mandates for institutional investors. The company also provides holistic and personal asset management, as well as independent specialized allocation advice for wealthy and institutional clients, and foundations and family offices. In addition, it offers digital and risk-optimized investment solutions for private investors and institutional clients with the use of artificial intelligence; and engages in tokenization of assets; and financial portfolio management. The company was formerly known as Lloyd Fonds AG. Laiqon AG was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Hamburg, Germany.

RTX.CO.longBusinessSummary: RTX A/S, a technology company, designs, manufactures, and sells wireless communication solutions in Denmark, France, Germany, rest of Europe, the United States, Hong Kong, Other Asia and Pacific, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Enterprise, ProAudio, and Healthcare. The company designs, develops, and manufactures wireless IP telephony products and sub-systems, including headsets, handsets, base stations, repeaters, location beacons, and cloud-based deployment and device management tools. It also provides microphone and instrument connectivity, wireless gaming headsets and peripherals, conference systems, content creation solutions, intercom systems for restaurants, construction sites, or complex systems for TV productions and large sporting events; and TeamEngage and Sheerlink platforms. In addition, the company offers wireless modules and products for continuous patient monitoring in hospitals. It serves offices and call centers, retail, logistics and storage, hospitality, sport and entertainment, healthcare and hospitals, industry and construction, content creation, secure facilities, live events and studios, venues and conference, manufacturing and production, and custom build industries. RTX A/S was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Nørresundby, Denmark.

MTRK.AS.longBusinessSummary: MotorK plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides software-as-a-service for the automotive retail industry in Italy, Spain, France, Germany, and the Benelux Union. The company provides WebSparK, a web platform for the automotive sector; LeadSparK, a CRM platform to support the activities of car dealerships and automotive manufacturers; and StockSparK, an automotive stock management platform. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Milan, Italy.

DETEC.HE.longBusinessSummary: Detection Technology Oyj engages in the provision of X-ray detector solutions for industrial, medical, and security applications in Finland and internationally. The company offers medical computed tomography (CT) detectors; security CT detectors; photon-counting detectors; flat-panel detectors; and line scan detectors, including linear detector arrays and detectors boards. It also provides myDT+ service portfolio comprising application testing, product commissioning, customer support, repair, failure analysis, extended warranty, warehousing, and training services. Its products are used in medical applications for computed tomography, dental, surgical, and veterinary imaging, as well as digital radiography; in security applications for Cabin and hold baggage, parcel and mail, cargo, container, vehicle, and person screening; and industrial applications comprising material sorting in the agriculture, forest, mining, and recycling industries, as well as production process control and quality inspection in the aerospace, automotive, battery, defense, food, pharmaceutical, renewable energy, oil, and gas industries. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Espoo, Finland.

VOC.MC.longBusinessSummary: Vocento, S.A., an independent communications company, develops content and services in Spain. It operates through ABC, Regional, Supplements and Magazines, Sports, Audiovisual, Classifieds, Digital Services, Gastronomy, Agencies, and Structure segments. The company is involved in the sale of copies in physical and digital form; advertising sales in print and digital editions; printing and distribution of press; sales of advertising and content primarily from various classifieds portals; radio, local radio, and national broadcasting; organizing concerts; communications agency activities; e-commerce; organization of gastronomic fairs and events; event organization; and sales of supplements and magazines, as well as the television and radio-related businesses. It also provides printing and digital services for businesses. The company was formerly known as Grupo Correo Prensa Española, S.A. and changed its name to Vocento, S.A. in May 2003. Vocento, S.A. was founded in 1854 and is headquartered in Bilbao, Spain.

ILP.MI.longBusinessSummary: ILPRA S.p.A. engages in the design, production, and sale of packaging machines worldwide. It offers tray sealers, filling machines, thermoformers, doypack systems, dosing units, weighing systems, beauty-sector packaging machines, fixed-weight portioning systems for hard cheese, and end-of-line solutions; and technological solutions. The company's products are used in the packaging of meat, dairy, ready meals, sliced meats, yogurt, poultry, seafood, sauces, fruits, cosmetics, medical, bakery, snacks, powders, baby food, pet food, dessert, vegetables, frozen food, ice cream, pasta, and vegan food, as well as medical and cosmetics sectors. The company was founded in 1955 and is based in Milan, Italy.

BYN2.VI.longBusinessSummary: Beyond Meat, Inc., a plant-based meat company, engages in the development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of plant-based meat products under the Beyond brand name in the United States and internationally. The company sells a range of plant-based meat products that replicates beef, pork, and poultry meats. It sells its products through grocery, mass merchandiser, club stores, and natural retailer channels, as well as various food-away-from-home channels, including restaurants, foodservice outlets, and schools. The company was formerly known as Savage River, Inc. and changed its name to Beyond Meat, Inc. in September 2018. Beyond Meat, Inc. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in El Segundo, California.

GEO.MI.longBusinessSummary: Geox S.p.A. creates, produces, promotes, and distributes footwear and apparel to retailers and end consumers in Italy, Europe, and internationally. The company offers shoes and apparel under the Geox brand name through wholesalers and franchising stores, Geox Shops, and e-commerce channels. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Montebelluna, Italy. Geox S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of LIR S.r.l.

OMER.MI.longBusinessSummary: OMER S.p.A. designs, develops, manufactures, and sells components and interior furnishings for railway vehicles in Italy, rest of European Union countries, and internationally. The company's products include high speed and regional trains, and subway interiors; upper, side, and lower external fairings and girths for carriages and locomotives; and sanitary modules for trains. OMER S.p.A. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Carini, Italy.

KSL.HE.longBusinessSummary: Keskisuomalainen Oyj engages in publishing, printing, and distributing newspapers and electronic communications in Finland. The company publishes 57-day newspapers, digital news media, local newspapers, and city newspapers. It also provides digital outdoor advertising solutions and research services. The company was founded in 1871 and is headquartered in Jyväskylä, Finland.

VME.DE.longBusinessSummary: Viromed Medical AG engages in the development, manufacture, and distribution of medical products in Germany and internationally. The company offers ViroCAP, an application in dermatology and wound treatment; and PulmoPlas for the treatment of severe respiratory infections. It also provides non-prescription health products in the cosmetics, nutritional supplement, and medical and nursing supplies. The company was formerly known as Fonterelli SPAC2 AG. Viromed Medical AG was founded in 2021 and is based in Rellingen, Germany.

PRO.MI.longBusinessSummary: Banca Profilo S.p.A. provides various banking and financial services to private, institutional, and corporate clients in Italy and internationally. It operates through the Private Banking, Investment Banking, Finance, Digital Bank, and Corporate Center segments. The company offers private banking, investment planning, asset planning and protection, investment club, and banking and trust services. It also provides investment management, and analysis and research services; financing and real estate services, as well as investment banking comprising corporate finance, capital market advisory, and market sounding services; and asset services, such as brokerage. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Milan, Italy. Banca Profilo S.p.A. is a subsidiary of Arepo BP S.p.A.

MLFMV.LS.longBusinessSummary: Farminveste, S.G.P.S., S.A., through its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of health care services in Portugal and internationally. The company distributes pharmaceutical products; operates hospitals and clinics; offers consultancy services; and conducts quantitative and qualitative market research studies in the healthcare sector. It also engages in information technologies activities; operation of pharmacy network under the Farmácias Portuguesas brand name; and real estate business. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Lisbon, Portugal. Farminveste, S.G.P.S., S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Associacao Nacional das Farmacias.

BIKE.DE.longBusinessSummary: Bike24 Holding AG operates an online cycling platform in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, rest of Europe, and internationally. It offers classic bicycles, e-bikes, parts, and accessories, as well as clothing products. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Dresden, Germany.

SSH1V.HE.longBusinessSummary: SSH Communications Security Oyj operates as a cybersecurity company for humans, systems, and networks in the Americas, the Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers secure business communication products comprising SalaX Secure Mail, a secure email encryption solution to protect confidential email communications; SalaX Secure Messaging, a communications platform for chats, audio, and video calls; Secure Sign, a secure electronic signature to documents or other assets; and SalaX Secure Collaboration, all in one solution that includes secure messaging and secure mail. It also provides secure access and secret management products, including PrivX Hybrid PAM Solution, an automated privileged access management solution for hybrid and multi-cloud environments; PrivX OT Edition, an on and off-site secure access management to any ICS/OT/IT target; and PrivX Key Management, a zero-trust encryption key management solution. In addition, the company offers secure file transfer and encryption products, such as Tectia SSH Client/Server for secure file transfer, remote access, and tunneling; Tectia SSH Server for z/OS, a secure file transfer protocol server software; NQX quantum safe encryptor, a quantum-safe solution that transmits large-scale data using future-proof quantum-safe algorithms. Further, it provides risk assessment services and discovery and audit self-services, as well as professional services. SSH Communications Security Oyj was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Helsinki, Finland.

BIKE.VI.longBusinessSummary: Bike24 Holding AG operates an online cycling platform in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, rest of Europe, and internationally. It offers classic bicycles, e-bikes, parts, and accessories, as well as clothing products. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Dresden, Germany.

YHSP.MC.longBusinessSummary: Hispanotels Inversiones Socimi S.A. engages in the investment in hotel, office, residential, and commercial real estate property markets. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Madrid, Spain.

IBT-B.ST.longBusinessSummary: Infant Bacterial Therapeutics AB (publ) operates as a clinical stage pharmaceutical company develops and markets drugs to prevent serious neonatal diseases affecting premature infants in Sweden. The company's lead drug candidate is IBP-9414, which has completed Phase III clinical studies to prevent necrotizing enterocolitis, as well as to improve feeding tolerance in premature infants. It is also developing IBP-1016 for the treatment of gastroschisis, a rare and severe birth abnormality in infants. In addition, its drug candidates include IBP-1118 to prevent retinopathy of prematurity that causes blindness in premature babies; and IBP-1122, indicated to eliminate vancomycin resistant enterococci that cause antibiotic resistant hospital infections. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

ALUNI.PA.longBusinessSummary: Unify Group SA engages in the thematic media business in France. The company offers various content, products, and services to audiences, as well as multi-media and multi-format brands. It also provides brand marketing, such as OTC or event-based advertising services; and performance marketing, including affiliation or programmatic advertising solutions. The company serves advertisers and general public through print, web, social media, TV, podcasts, and events. The company was formerly known as Reworld Media Société Anonyme and changed its name to Unify Group SA in June 2026. Unify Group SA was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Boulogne-Billancourt, France.

FC9.DE.longBusinessSummary: FCR Immobilien & Vermögensverwaltungs GmbH & Co. KG is based in Krailling, Germany.

NTG.DE.longBusinessSummary: Nabaltec AG develops, manufactures, and distributes specialized products based on aluminum hydroxide and aluminum oxide in Germany, rest of Europe, the United States, and internationally. It operates in two segments: Functional Fillers and Specialty Oxides. The company offers flame retardants filling materials for plastic industry for use in data centers, photovoltaic and wind power plants, tunnels, airports, high-rise buildings, and electronic devices; fillers and additives as coating materials in separators and electrodes in lithium-ion batteries, all natural barrier layer and flame retardants in battery covers; ceramic raw material to be applied in the refractory industry, in technical ceramics, and abrasives industry; and specialized raw material for ballistics microelectronics and ceramic fillers. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Schwandorf, Germany.

WOLF.DE.longBusinessSummary: Meta Wolf AG, together with its subsidiaries, supplies and trades construction materials in Germany, the European Union, and internationally. The company provides software services; IT and solar systems; renewable energies; solar products; semiconductor technologies; and green building products comprising materials, tiles, and natural stone. It also provides digital platforms in the areas of e-commerce, e-marketing, e-finance, and e-government. In addition, it manufactures solar energy products and systems, such as solar panels, advanced inverters, batteries, software applications, and integrated solar energy systems for individuals and businesses. The company was formerly known as Mühl Product & Service Aktiengesellschaft and changed its name to Meta Wolf AG in September 2022. Meta Wolf AG is based in Kranichfeld, Germany.

FUM.MI.longBusinessSummary: Franchi Umberto Marmi S.p.A. provides marble slabs and blocks in Italy and internationally. The company offers Calacatta, Statuario, Bianco Venatino, White Carrara and Joy, Zebrino, Bardiglio, Manhattan Grey, and Grigio Collemandina marbles. It also operates a Franchi store. Franchi Umberto Marmi S.p.A. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Carrara, Italy. Franchi Umberto Marmi S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of Holding Franchi S.p.A.

UD.MI.longBusinessSummary: Unidata S.p.A. provides fiber and networking, cloud and data center, and IoT and smart solutions in Italy. It offers FIBER, secure SD-WAN, and wireless connectivity; voice and collaboration; iaas and cloud services, storageaaS, back upaaS, disaster recoveryaaS, virtual private cloud, and managed services; cyber security comprising SOC, aaS firewall, endpoint security, and network and user protection; data center services, including colocation-housing and bare metal, interconnection band; and IoT services, such as smart metering and city. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Rome, Italy. Unidata S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of Uninvest S.R.L.

TVRB.PA.longBusinessSummary: Téléverbier SA engages in the operation of ski lifts in Switzerland. It offers hiking, mountain biking, summer and winter activities, skiing and snowboarding, and freeriding activities. The company operates ski schools, as well as restaurants; and provides accommodation and technical services. Téléverbier SA was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Verbier, Switzerland.

AGP.MI.longBusinessSummary: Altea Green Power S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, supplies and manages renewable energy plants in Italy and the United States. The company engages in the development and building of industrial-scale rooftop and ground-mounted photovoltaic plants, agrivoltaics plant, wind farms, and battery energy storage systems; application of grid connection permits; completion of administrative procedures to obtain functional permits for the implementation of plants; and preliminary and final design and engineering works. It also provides turnkey solutions; energy audit; PPA energy services, revamping, and transfer of surface right of industrial roofs; consulting services; and financing of plant services. The company serves companies, funds, and investors. Altea Green Power S.p.A. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Rivoli, Italy.

ALFLE.PA.longBusinessSummary: Fleury Michon SA manufactures and sells food products in France and internationally. The company offers cold cuts, such as pork ham, chicken and turkey breast, veggie slices, roasts, pastrami, and pan-fried meats; prepared meals; surimi; halal food products; and new products comprising ham-flavored veggie slices, curry cumin veggie slices, easy meals, and vegetable matchsticks coral lentils. It also provides ingredients for cooking, including diced, matchstick, grated, and sliced pork; sliced chicken, chicken tenders, and chicken matchsticks; and soft grated cheese. The company also exports its products. The company was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Pouzauges, France.

ESENSE.HE.longBusinessSummary: Enersense International Oyj, together with its subsidiaries, provides energy solutions in Finland and internationally. The company operates through Power, Connectivity, and Energy Transition segments. It offers design, construction, and maintenance of transmission grids, electric substations, and wind and solar farms; and provides energy transition solutions, such as power plants, district heating networks, hydrogen facilities, hydropower plants, shipyards, and steel and piping structures, as well as energy storage systems. The company provides mobile and fixed network services, and related infrastructure; and designs, constructs, maintains, and repairs fixed and wireless telecommunications networks and infrastructure. It serves customers operating in energy transmission and production, industrial energy transition, telecommunications, and data centers. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Pori, Finland.

ILKKA.HE.longBusinessSummary: Ilkka Oyj, together with its subsidiaries, provides professional, data, and technology services for digital marketing and communications in Finland and internationally. The company operates a WordPress digital agency under the Evermade name; social media marketing agency under the MySome brand name; B2B marketing and strategic marketing under the Myynninmaailma; provides data for increasing sales under the Profinder brand name; and marketing and communications technology under the Liana and Ungapped brand names. It also offers financial, investment, human resources, development, information management, and real estate services. In addition, it provides a customer data and marketing automation platform that integrates and manages customer data from online and offline channels to support data-driven marketing and customer engagement. The company was formerly known as Ilkka-Yhtymä Oyj and changed its name to Ilkka Oyj in May 2022. Ilkka Oyj was founded in 1906 and is based in Seinäjoki, Finland.

INDB.MI.longBusinessSummary: Indel B S.p.A. manufactures and supplies cooling and refrigeration systems worldwide. It offers parking coolers for industrial vehicles, drug transport, refrigerated vehicles, aeronautical, agricultural and earthmoving, electric vehicles, special vehicles, military vehicles, commercial and industrial vehicles, leisure, and trams, trains, and subway; spare parts; and 24V air conditioners, built-in refrigerators, portable refrigerators, and electro-medical refrigerators for automotive. The company also provides freezers, cooling boxes and units, wine cellars and coolers, water heaters, and safes for marine; hotel and cruise ship minibars; and frigo milk products. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Sant'agata Feltria, Italy. Indel B S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of Amp.Fin S.R.L.

LEIF.VI.longBusinessSummary: Leifheit Aktiengesellschaft, together with its subsidiaries, develops and distributes household products in Germany, Central and Eastern Europe, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Household, Wellbeing, and Private Label. The Household segment provides cleaning, laundry care, and kitchen goods under the Leifheit brand. The Wellbeing segment offers various personal and kitchen scales and room air treatment products under the Soehnle brand. The Private Label segment develops and manufactures kitchen goods and laundry care under the Birambeau and Herby brands. It offers its products through in-stores and online shops. Leifheit Aktiengesellschaft was founded in 1959 and is based in Nassau, Germany.

TCM.CO.longBusinessSummary: TCM Group A/S manufactures and sells kitchen and furniture products for bathrooms and storage in Denmark, Norway, and internationally. The company offers kitchen, bathroom and utility room fixtures, and sliding door cabinets under the Svane Køkkenet, Tvis køkken, Nettoline, AUBO, and private label brands. It also manufactures do-it-yourself solutions for private label and independent kitchen stores. In addition, the company supplies e-commerce kitchen business Celebert, which operates under the brands kitchn.dk, billigskabe. dk, Celebert, and Just Wood. TCM Group A/S was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Holstebro, Denmark.

LEI.DE.longBusinessSummary: Leifheit Aktiengesellschaft, together with its subsidiaries, develops and distributes household products in Germany, Central and Eastern Europe, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Household, Wellbeing, and Private Label. The Household segment provides cleaning, laundry care, and kitchen goods under the Leifheit brand. The Wellbeing segment offers various personal and kitchen scales and room air treatment products under the Soehnle brand. The Private Label segment develops and manufactures kitchen goods and laundry care under the Birambeau and Herby brands. It offers its products through in-stores and online shops. Leifheit Aktiengesellschaft was founded in 1959 and is based in Nassau, Germany.

VIH1.DE.longBusinessSummary: VIB Vermögen AG, engages in the development, acquisition, and management of commercial real estate properties in Germany. It operates through Commercial Portfolio and Institutional Business segments. The company's portfolio includes properties in logistics, light industrial, and office asset classes. It also provides property management services and solutions for institutional investors. VIB Vermögen AG was founded in 1993 and is based in Neuburg an der Donau, Germany.

LEMON.HE.longBusinessSummary: Lemonsoft Oyj, a software company, designs, develops, and delivers enterprise resource planning software solutions in Finland and internationally. It offers enterprise management system, such as business intelligence, project management, integrations, working time tracking, work shift planning, payroll and personnel administration, production control, logistics, financial management, customer relationship management, web service, and mobile application solutions; and LemonAI, an artificial intelligence solution. The company also provides Regista, a business processes product; Metsys, a customized WMS solution; Timecard, working time tracking product; Duunissa, a working time tracking for small businesses; Logentia, a transportation optimization product; Finazilla, a business information reporting product; Lixani, a construction company operations management product; and Talosofta, a building industry quote calculation product. In addition, it offers Finvoicer, an invoice lifecycle management product; Applirent, a rental business management product; Spotilla, a service, maintenance, and field work supervision product; and EasyInvoice invoicing software. The company serves industrial manufacturing and wholesale and specialty trade companies. Lemonsoft Oyj was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Vaasa, Finland.

NVM.VI.longBusinessSummary: Novem Group S.A. develops and supplies trim parts and decorative function elements for car interiors in the automotive industry. Its product portfolio includes instrument panels, centre consoles, door trims, and belt lines, and decorative functional elements in car interiors. The company also offers real wood, aluminium, carbon, premium synthetic, textiles, stone, and expanded surface products; and seamless integrated switches. It operates in Czech Replic, Germany, Italy, Slovenia, Honduras, Mexico, the United States, China, and Asia. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Contern, Luxembourg.

MBK.DE.longBusinessSummary: Merkur PrivatBank KgaA offers various private banking products and services in Germany. The company provides business, private, and securities accounts; fixed deposits; wealth management services; master cards; and SME, real estate, and developer financing, as well as lease refinancing. It also offers advisory, online and mobile banking services. The company was founded in 1923 and is based in Munich, Germany.

ALSOG.PA.longBusinessSummary: Sogeclair SA provides engineering and manufacturing services to the aeronautics, space, civil and military transport in France, rest of Europe, the Americas, Asia Pacific, and internationally. The company engages in the provision of engineering services in aerostructures, cabins interiors of simulated equipment aircraft and on-board equipment; and design and supply of structural thermoplastic, complex metal sub-assemblies, cabin interior furniture and mechanisms, metal additive manufacturing and simulated cockpit equipment. It is also involved in the design and manufacture of special industrial and military vehicles, as well as multi-mission ground drones. In addition, the company engages in the design and supply of simulators; and development of simulation software platforms. Sogeclair SA was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Blagnac, France.

DORMY.ST.longBusinessSummary: Dormy Corporation AB (publ) engages in the retailing of golf equipment in Sweden and Europe. The company offers golf clubs, golf grips, gloves, balls, trolleys and bags, clothes and shoes, gadgets, and accessories. It sells its products through physical stores and e-commerce platforms. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Örebro, Sweden.

NVM.DE.longBusinessSummary: Novem Group S.A. develops and supplies trim parts and decorative function elements for car interiors in the automotive industry. Its product portfolio includes instrument panels, centre consoles, door trims, and belt lines, and decorative functional elements in car interiors. The company also offers real wood, aluminium, carbon, premium synthetic, textiles, stone, and expanded surface products; and seamless integrated switches. It operates in Czech Replic, Germany, Italy, Slovenia, Honduras, Mexico, the United States, China, and Asia. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Contern, Luxembourg.

ALAFY.PA.longBusinessSummary: AFYREN SAS provides biobased products to replace petroleum-based molecules in France. It offers acetic, propionic, butyric and isobutyric, valeric and isovaleric, and caproic acids. The company's products are used in the flavors and fragrances, lubricants and functional fluids, feed, food, life sciences, and materials science markets. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Clermont-Ferrand, France.

EPIS-B.ST.longBusinessSummary: Episurf Medical AB (publ), a medical device company, designs and manufactures implants and surgical instruments in Germany, Sweden, rest of Europe, the United States, and internationally. It provides Episealer Knee for repairing focal cartilage and bone defects to reduce pain and increase mobility in the patient's knee joint; Episealer implant, which is designed to fit anatomy and size of the lesion; Episealer toolkit; and Episealer Patellofemoral System, a system to treat osteoarthritis limited to the patellofemoral part of the knee joint. The company also offers Epioscopy to identify and visualize femoral knee joint cartilage and bone lesions, and tibia, as well as defects on the cruciate ligaments and menisci; Epiguide, a surgical drill guide; and µiFidelity, a web platform for order management, communication, personalized design, and surgical pre-planning. In addition, it is developing Episealer MTP implant, an implant for the MTP joint of the big toe in the foot. Further, the company offers Talus Osteotomy Guide (TOG) that is designed to fit on the patient's distal tibia using CT and MRI images; MRI protocol to ensure correct damage assessment, 3D visualization, and device design; and Damage Marking Report (DMR) that enables 3D visualization of damage in the joint surface and underlaying bone defects, as well as other findings relevant when selecting the right treatment for the patient. It has logistics and warehouse properties in Helsinki and Kerava. The company was formerly known as Diamorph Medtech AB and changed its name to Episurf Medical AB (publ) in 2010. Episurf Medical AB (publ) was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

DEF.DE.longBusinessSummary: DEFAMA Deutsche Fachmarkt AG, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a real estate company in Germany. The company acquires, manages, and leases retail properties in small and medium-sized cities. It also generates revenue from feed-in-tariffs related to photovoltaic systems. In addition, the company offers passed-on construction and advertising services. DEFAMA Deutsche Fachmarkt AG was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Berlin, Germany.

DAM.DE.longName: DATA MODUL Aktiengesellschaft Produktion und Vertrieb von elektronischen Systemen
DAM.DE.longBusinessSummary: DATA MODUL Aktiengesellschaft Produktion und Vertrieb von elektronischen Systemen, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes flatbed displays, monitors, electronic subassemblies, and information systems in Germany and internationally. It operates in two segments, Displays and Systems. The company offers hardware components, including optical and structural bonding; custom, TFT, Mip, e-paper, passive, miniLED, and OLED displays, as well as LED solutions; touch solutions, such as easyTOUCH starter kit, PCAP products, custom touch sensors and tails, and software and tuning; electronics comprising eMotion LCD controller boards, single board computers, and computer-on-modules; peripherals, which include core components, encoders and operating elements, cables, power supply, colling solutions, display and monitor accessories, and other products; cover glass; digital signage products; and monitors and panel PCs. It also provides software solutions, such as operating systems; application software comprising easyANALYZER and maXcs software suite; cyber security; cloud services; and AI and ML solutions, which consists of machine vision systems, integrated solutions, and embedded AI platforms. In addition, the company offers various services, including design-in; research and development, such as electronics design, mechanical and system engineering, process development, software, mock-up and prototyping, and proof-of-concept; qualification, testing, documentation, and compliance; manufacturing; logistics and corporate; and life management. Further, it sells easyPanel and easyEmbedded solutions. The company serves industrial automation, mobility, smart building and white goods, medical and healthcare, entertainment, and smart retail and signage markets. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany. DATA MODUL Aktiengesellschaft Produktion und Vertrieb von elektronischen Systemen operates as a subsidiary of Arrow Electronics, Inc.

DAM.VI.longName: DATA MODUL Aktiengesellschaft Produktion und Vertrieb von elektronischen Systemen
DAM.VI.longBusinessSummary: DATA MODUL Aktiengesellschaft Produktion und Vertrieb von elektronischen Systemen, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes flatbed displays, monitors, electronic subassemblies, and information systems in Germany and internationally. It operates in two segments, Displays and Systems. Further, it sells easyPanel and easyEmbedded solutions.
