ITW.MI.longBusinessSummary: Itway S.p.A. engages in the design, building, and distribution of technologies and solutions in cybersecurity and resiliency, artificial intelligence (AI), cloud computing, big data, and infrastructure to businesses and public administrations. Itway S.p.A. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Milan, Italy.

GML.MI.longBusinessSummary: G.M. Leather S.p.A. engages in the manufacture, marketing, and sale of semi-finished and finished leathers in Italy and internationally. It offers its products for footwear, furniture, leather goods, and fashion sectors. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Arzignano, Italy.

HSPG.OL.longBusinessSummary: Høland og Setskog Sparebank provides banking services for the retail and corporate markets in Norway. The company offers current, deposit, and savings accounts; business, investment, agricultural, and client accounts; bank and credit cards; eInvoice; mobile payments; and mobile and online banking. It also provides insurance products for cars, electric scooters, boats, motorcycles, mopeds, jet skis, caravans, motorhomes, ATVs, tractors, snowmobiles, trailers, and veteran cars; houses, household items, travel, cottages, valuable items, and drones; health, child, disability, critical illness, life, and accident; dogs, cats, and horses; and company, employees, and agriculture applications. In addition, the company offers bank, BSU, mutual fund, micro, and retirement savings; pension products; car loans, mortgages, senior loans for apartments, green mortgages, energy-saving loans, framework loans, consumer loans, cottage loans, fixed-rate loans, and refinancing of mortgages, as well as loans for boats, motorcycles, caravans, motorhomes, ATVs, and snowmobiles; refinancing of consumer debt; bank guarantees, business and construction loans, factoring and invoice management, overdraft, and leasing; and consulting and accounting services. The company was formerly known as Holand Sparebank and changed its name to Høland og Setskog Sparebank in July 2010. Høland og Setskog Sparebank was incorporated in 1849 and is headquartered in Bjørkelangen, Norway.

1GBS.DE.longBusinessSummary: GBS Software AG, a holding company, through its subsidiaries, engages in the metal recycling and payment processing activities. It is involved in the recycling and disposal of waste, such as recycling of electronic scrap and other mixtures of materials for the purpose of recovering iron, non-ferrous, and precious metals, as well as trading in all primary, intermediate, and final products from these processes. GBS Software AG was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany.

ELSA.MI.longBusinessSummary: ELSA Solutions S.p.A. develops products and solutions for industrial automation and power electronics in Italy. It offers electric motors, such as direct current and asynchronous motors; inverters; soft start; DC converters; and tachogenerators. The company also provides hardware and software projects; retrofit e upgrade; service and maintenance; and automation courses. ELSA Solutions S.p.A. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Imola, Italy.

ALSGD.PA.longBusinessSummary: SpineGuard SA provides designs, develops, and markets medical devices in the United States, Europe, Latin America, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East. The company offers PediGuard drilling instruments comprising straight, curved, cannulated, PsiFGuard, and threaded PediGuard products. It also provides DSG Connect app that provides surgeons real time visualization of the audio feedback from the DSG Technology during pedicle drillings to ease the signal interpretation. The company's products are used in orthopedic robots and dental implantology. SpineGuard SA was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Vincennes, France.

NETUM.HE.longBusinessSummary: Netum Group Oyj operates as an IT services company in Finland. It develops and maintains digital, embedded systems and cloud, system continuity, data and integration, cyber security, change management, customer experience optimisation, and SaaS services for education sector, as well as IT training and recruitment services. The company also provides Atomi Education, an electronic certificates and documents; AtomiSign, an electronic signature solution; Spark, a course feedback tool; Fokus, a monitoring the progress of studies; Happi, an application and service processes into an intuitive and accessible solutions; Truugo, Electronic data interchange documentation and testing; and NIaaS, an integration services. In addition, it offers IT consulting and software development services, as well as software products to private and public sectors. Netum Group Oyj was founded in 2000 and is based in Tampere, Finland.

ELEAV.HE.longBusinessSummary: Elecster Oyj designs, manufactures, and markets UHT milk processing lines, aseptic packaging lines, pasteurized milk packaging lines, and related packaging materials in Finland, Europe, Asia, Africa, and internationally. It operates in the Industrial and Consumer products segments. The company offers dairies, wallpapers, and grass mats. It also provides a renowned pioneer in pouch packaging lines for ultra-high temperature (UHT) milk; pouch filling machines; ecological pouch packaging materials; sterilizers; aseptic and pasteurized pouch machines; autopackers, and auto boxers; ElecTesters; and multilayer packaging films, including ready-made rolls with customer-designed prints. In addition, the company offers after-sales services, such as technical support, maintenance, and training. Elecster Oyj was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Akaa, Finland.

OPTS.MI.longBusinessSummary: OPT S.p.A. operates as a consulting and training company in Italy. It offers digital tools, such as E-PHARMA 360, a tool for healthcare facilities, hospital pharmacies, and community pharmacies that combines therapeutic algorithms, pharmacoeconomic, outcomes, and patient quality of life; E-NUTRITION, a multidisciplinary tool for the analysis of the nutritional support process for the oncology patient; e-TMD, a digital tool for healthcare facilities that allows the digitalization of the activities; HGI, a platform for healthcare facilities for the measurement and evaluation of key performance indicators of the patient journey; and 3G, a tool for general practitioners, territorial specialists, and hospital specialists for the integration of the PDTA. It also provides digital solutions to support the clinical and organizational governance of healthcare facilities; and delivers and organizes residential, FSC, and blended training sessions. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Milan, Italy.

NRDAMP.ST.longBusinessSummary: NordAmps AB designs, manufactures, and sells semiconductor circuits for communication systems. The company offers low-noise amplifiers (LNAs) for high frequency applications, such as satellite communication, telecom infrastructure, 5G/6G, defense, radar, and broadband communication. It also develops customer-specific integrated circuits and application-specific integrated circuits for specific customer and system requirements. NordAmps AB was founded in 2016 and is based in Lund, Sweden.

ALBOA.PA.longBusinessSummary: BOA Concept SAS provides solutions for intralogistics in France, Europe, Canada, and internationally. The company offers automated parcel receiving and sorting, automated stretch wrapping, automated truck loading, mixed palletizing robot, and placing robot solutions for shuttle bins; and tray forming, labelling, parcel monitoring solutions with weighing and camera vision, as well as automated document deposit, insertion of parcel wedges, void reduction and lid closing, taping, and strapping. It also provides automated station picking, pick to light/put to light, and picking robot solutions; conveying, multi-level spiral and vertical elevating, and heavy load conveying solutions; and drive and visualize solutions. The company serves retailers, e-merchant, and logistics providers, as well as other heavy industries. BOA Concept SAS was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Saint-Étienne, France.

ALVAP.PA.longBusinessSummary: Kumulus Vape S.A., an e-merchant, sells and distributes vaping products and related products in France. The company operates two sales platforms, such as kumulusvape.fr and kmls.fr. The company offers equipment, including electronic cigarettes, boxes and batteries, puffs, and pods, as well as clearomizers, resistors, tanks, drippers, and pod cartridges; e-liquids; accessories, such as drip tips, resistive threads, cottons, resistors, tools, batteries, cases and storage, and DIY products. Kumulus Vape S.A. was founded in 2012 and is based in Lyon, France.

ICO.ST.longBusinessSummary: Iconovo AB (publ) develops inhaled medicinal products in Sweden. The company offers ICOres, a multi-dose dry powder inhaler; ICOcap, a capsule based dry powder inhaler; ICOone, a single-dose disposable dry powder inhaler; and ICOpre, a pre-metered dry powder inhaler; and ICOone nasal single-dose dry powder inhaler for nasal use. It serves generic companies. The company has a collaboration agreement with Lonza to develop spray-dried formulations of an intranasal biologic drug; and agreement with Kiox Pharma to develop an inhalable treatment for interstitial lung disease. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Lund, Sweden.

VNT.MI.longBusinessSummary: Vantea SMART S.p.A., an information technology company, engages in the provision of cybersecurity solutions and services in Italy. It develops software products and digital e-commerce platforms. The company also provides IT services relating to design, implementation, and maintenance of identity, access, and API management projects; and security operations services in the field of end point security countermeasures and SOC. In addition, it offers concierge services; training services; and consultancy services in the field of system integration, software development, project development, and product development activities. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Rome, Italy.

AMM.DE.longName: The Grounds Real Estate Development AG
AMM.DE.shortName: The Grounds R.Est. Dev. AG    N
AMM.DE.longBusinessSummary: The Grounds Real Estate Development AG, a real estate company, engages in the development, management, rental, and sale of residential properties in Germany. It also provides portfolio management, privatization, property project development, and asset management services for residential properties. The Grounds Real Estate Development AG was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Berlin, Germany.

BARRA.OL.longBusinessSummary: Barramundi Group Ltd. commercially farms, distributes, and sells seawater barramundi products in Singapore. It also develops and sells autogenous vaccines for fishes; farms seabass; imports and trades in fishes; and engages in general trade activities. In addition, the company operates ocean farms; and the development and sale of vaccines for fish. It sells its products under the Kühlbarra, Cone Bay Ocean Barramundi, fassler, and St. John's Seabass. Barramundi Group Ltd. was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Singapore.

EAV.MI.longBusinessSummary: Emma Villas S.p.A. provides short-term rentals of villas, country houses, and residences in Italy. It also offers property management services. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Siena, Italy.

OKEAC.CO.longBusinessSummary: Det Østasiatiske Kompagni A/S operates as an investment company. It engages in production of acrylics in Thailand. The company was formerly known as EAC Invest A/S and changed its name to Det Østasiatiske Kompagni A/S in June 2024. Det Østasiatiske Kompagni A/S was founded in 1897 and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

TENEO.ST.longBusinessSummary: Teneo AI AB (publ) provides Al-powered and automated d voice phone calls conversations solutions through its Teneo platform in Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers Teneo which connects voice with digital channels, and orchestrates AI implementation; Teneo AI Call Guardian; Teneo agentless contact center; Teneo contact center and customer service automation; Teneo conversational IVR; Teneo LLM orchestrator; Teneo Voice AI; and Teneo Accuracy Booster solutions. It also provides Teneo Engine, an API calls generation platform; and Teneo Data, an analytics platform to review users' conversations and enhance the conversational AI solutions. The company was formerly known as Artificial Solutions International AB (publ) and changed its name to Teneo AI AB (publ) in August 2024. Teneo AI AB (publ) was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

ELZ.MC.longBusinessSummary: Asturiana De Laminados, S.A., trading as elZinc, develops and manufactures rolled zinc strips in Spain and internationally. The company offers roof tiles, honeycomb and composite panels, rainwater systems; standing seam clips, strippers, structural underlays; clips, and zinc solutions for facades. Asturiana de Laminados, S.A. was founded in 2006 and is based in Pola de Lena, Spain. Asturiana De Laminados, S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Laminados del Principado, S.A.

ALWF.PA.longBusinessSummary: WINFARM Société anonyme provides consulting, services, and supplies of equipment and solutions to the agricultural and livestock industry worldwide. The company also designs and manufactures food supplements and hygiene products for livestock; sale of agricultural supplies under the VITAL CONCEPT brand for the mixed crop-livestock market; and operates Bel Orient farm. In addition, it provides technical advice services; and training courses for professionals in for agricultural, tertiary professionals, and industry. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Loudéac, France.

ERMA.ST.longBusinessSummary: Enorama Pharma AB (publ), a pharmaceutical company, develops, manufactures, and sells tobacco-free white snus in Sweden. It offers its products under the NIC-S brand name. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

ALQWA.PA.longBusinessSummary: Qwamplify engages in the provision of digital marketing solutions in France. It designs and deploys plans to recruit, convert, engage, and retain consumers or customers through the web or in stores. Qwamplify was formerly known as Custom Solutions SA. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Levallois-Perret, France.

M3B0.DE.longBusinessSummary: Pyramid AG engages in the development and manufacture of information technology solutions for the retail, financial, and industrial markets in Germany. The company provides hardware solutions, including interactive kiosks, and network and security servers, and self-service terminals. The company also offers touchscreen devices for point-of-sale and point-of-service applications. In addition, it provides scalable and future-proof solutions such as immutable storage and hybrid cloud integrations. The company was formerly known as Pyramid Computer GmbH. Pyramid AG was founded in 1985 and is based in Munich, Germany.

NEDSE.AS.longBusinessSummary: MKB Nedsense N.V. engages in the financing and lending of funds to natural persons and legal entities. It offers guarantees and/or other securities to third parties for its obligations and/or for obligations for companies in its investment portfolio. The company was formerly known as Nedsense Enterprises N.V. amd changed its name to MKB Nedsense N.V. in February 2018. MKB Nedsense N.V. was founded in 1999 and is based in Bussum, the Netherlands.

BIOVIC-B.ST.longBusinessSummary: Biovica International AB (publ), a biotech company, develops and commercializes blood-based biomarker assays for oncologists monitor cancer progression in the European Union, the United States, and Asia. The company engages in the development of DiviTum TKa, a monitoring tool for patients with early or metastatic breast cancer undergoing treatment with CDK4/6 inhibitors. It serves cancer institutes and pharmaceutical companies. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Uppsala, Sweden.

LOYAL.ST.longBusinessSummary: Loyal Solutions A/S engages in the development, implementation, and operation of SaaS loyalty solutions based on payment/card-linked technology worldwide. It offers LoyalTfacts, a SaaS platform. The company provides solutions for loyalty, airlines, financial, airlines, malls, hospitality, telecom, security, and technology industries. Loyal Solutions A/S was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

IRIS.ST.longBusinessSummary: Irisity AB (publ) provides AI-powered video analytics solutions in Sweden, Israel, Hungary, the United States, Colombia, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, the United Kingdom, Norway and the UAE and internationally. The company offers IRIS+, an open and scalable software with video analytics and AI; AI detection agents that constantly watch for activities and reliably notify in real-time allowing for a quick response; and personalized AI algorithms that are tailored to specific needs and requirements of different environments. It also provides hardware products, such as Irisity Edge 10, a pre-configured appliance that is typically co-deployed with a camera system at the surveillance site; Irisity Edge for Axis, a special IRIS+ Edge version that runs inside Axis ARTPEC-7 and ARTPEC-8 cameras as an axis camera application platform application connecting to the cloud; and Custom Edge, that allows to run IRIS+ Edge analytics on own custom hardware, which is deployed either on-site or in a centralized location. In addition, the company offers camera filters, operator, and hardware solutions. The company serves critical infrastructure, safe cities, transportation, healthcare, retail, education markets, solar farms, data centers, and waterworks. It operates through a network of resellers, partners, OEMs, security companies, and camera manufacturers. The company was formerly known as Mindmancer AB (publ) and changed its name to Irisity AB (publ) in August 2017. Irisity AB (publ) was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden.

ALGTR.PA.longBusinessSummary: Groupe Tera SA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the analysis of chemical air pollutants in France and internationally. It offers toxicology and environmental analysis laboratory services; measures chemical pollutants; develops, industrializes, and markets sensors to measure air quality in real-time; and develops applications for real-time analysis of air quality. The company also offers air and respiratory protection technologies and devices for the treatment of respiratory viruses. In addition, it provides TERA Sensors, and Atmotrack data solutions. Groupe Tera SA was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Crolles, France.

EGB.MI.longBusinessSummary: E-Globe S.p.A. engages in the online sale of air conditioners, boilers, stoves, solar panels, fan coils, heat pumps, electric pumps, and water heaters in Italy and internationally. It offers air conditioners, such as conditioners, air conditioners without outdoor units, fan coil units, climate control solutions, controlled mechanical ventilation, aspirators, heat pumps, portable air conditioners, air barriers, dehumidifiers, and air purifiers; and heating products, including boilers, stoves, gas convectors, heated towel rails, fireplaces, hybrid systems, water heaters, radiators, heating lamps, UVC lamps, and thermo cookers. The company also provides electric pumps, water purification products, toilet shredders, and environmental sanitization products; bathroom furniture, such as sanitary toilet cisterns and plates, taps, shower columns, shower heads and shower arms, ups and downs, built-in bodies, and bathroom accessories; and garden furniture, including garden showers, garden fountains, sun loungers, and garden lights; electric car charging stations, thermal solar panels, garden solar showers, and photovoltaic panels and systems. In addition, it offers fireplace accessories, accessories biomass stoves, electric pumps accessories, gas stove accessories, boiler accessories, air conditioner accessories, solar thermal accessories, heat pump accessories, hybrid system accessories, accessories for radiators, fan coil accessories, accessories for water heaters, faucet accessories, and sanitary accessories. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Cirò Marina, Italy. E-Globe S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of Ecan Holding S.r.l.

ENY.MI.longBusinessSummary: Energy S.p.A. designs and distributes energy storage systems for energy from renewable sources to residential, commercial, and industrial applications in Italy, rest of Europe, and rest of the world. It offers outdoor, indoor, and container solutions; single phase, three phase, and hybrid inverters; low and high voltage batteries, as well as rack cabinets; sun chargers; and accessories. Energy S.p.A. was founded in 2013 and is based in Rovereto, Italy.

CLS-B.ST.longBusinessSummary: Clinical Laserthermia Systems AB (publ) engages in the development of treatment tools for diseased tissue under the TRANBERG brand in Sweden. It offers TRANBERG, a thermal therapy system designed to deliver laser energy to heat the target tissue. The company also provides mobile laser unit, a controlling component with a wavelength of 1064 nanometers that provides multiple options to control treatment. In addition, it offers various gauge laser applicators and introducers, as well as provides temperature and treatment monitoring devices. The company has a strategic partnership with ClearPoint Neuro Inc. for the development of ClearPoint Prism, a Neuro Laser Therapy System. Clinical Laserthermia Systems AB (publ) was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Lund, Sweden.

EFFH.ST.longBusinessSummary: Effnetplattformen Holding AB (publ) develops and licenses networking software solutions in Sweden and internationally. It offers lines; header compression solutions, such as Effnet ROHCTM, Effnet Backhaul Compression (Effnet BHCTM) for telecom, mobile, and broadband industries; and 5G protocol stack solutions for terminals and base stations. It is also involved in the research and development of network technologies for IP-based networks and many related forums, including IETF and 3GPP. In addition, it provides pre and after-sales services. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Luleå, Sweden.

ONCOZ.ST.longBusinessSummary: OncoZenge AB (publ), is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, engages in the development of treatment for pain relief in patients suffering from oral pain caused by radiation therapy and chemotherapy for cancer in Sweden. The company offers BupiZenge, which is in Phase 3 clinical trials for the treatment of pain in the oral cavity. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Bromma, Sweden.

SPAGO.ST.longBusinessSummary: Spago Nanomedical AB (publ), a nanomedicine company, engages in the development projects based on a platform of polymeric materials for diagnosis and treatment of life-threatening and debilitating diseases in Sweden. Its products include SpagoPix (SN132D), an MRI contrast agent, which is under Phase I development stage for the treatment of breast cancer, and under Phase II development stage for the treatment of liver and pancreas cancer, as well as offers Tumorad (SN201), a radionuclide therapy for treatment of cancer. The company was formerly known as Spago Imaging AB (publ) and changed its name to Spago Nanomedical AB (publ) in May 2014. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Lund, Sweden.

VIVE.ST.longBusinessSummary: Vivesto AB develops, develops, markets, and sells drugs in the field of human and veterinary oncology in Sweden. Its lead product, Paccal Vet, is a formulation of paclitaxel with its XR-17 encapsulation technology for the treatment of canine mastocytoma. The company also provides Apealea, an injectable formulation of paclitaxel for the treatment of various cancers. In addition, it develops Cantrixil, a drug candidate for the treatment of advanced cancer, and Docetaxel micellar for the treatment of prostate cancer. The company was formerly known as Oasmia Pharmaceutical AB (publ) and changed its name to Vivesto AB in March 2022. Vivesto AB was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Solna, Sweden.

NICA.ST.longBusinessSummary: Nanologica AB (publ), a life science tools company, develops, manufactures, and sells nanoporous silica particles in China, India, Turkey, the United States, and internationally. The company offers NLAB Saga, a silica-based purification media for preparative chromatography that is developed for the purification of peptide drugs, such as insulin and GLP-1 analogues; NLAB Idun, an ion exchange product for robust, reproducible, and efficient downstream purification of GLP-1 analogues and other peptides; NLAB Idun SP, a strong cation exchanger with sulfopropyl groups as ligands; NLAB Idun Q, a strong anion exchanger with a quaternary amine ligand; and NLAB Siv, a non-silica-based media for purification by preparative chromatography used for products outside the peptide range. It also provides high-performance liquid chromatography, a separation method based on different substances in a solution passing through a column at different paces; and analytical chromatography, an analysis method in the pharmaceutical and food industries. The company's products are used to purify substances with a focus on peptide drugs for the treatment of diabetes and obesity. It serves pharmaceutical companies, as well as contract manufactures of insulin and insulin analogues, GLP-1 analogues, biosimilars to insulin and GLP-1 analogues, and other peptide drugs. Nanologica AB (publ) was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Södertälje, Sweden.

CFC.DE.longBusinessSummary: aconnic AG provides telecommunication system solutions in Germany and internationally. It offers gigabit systems, remote powering systems, virtualized networks, Whitebox communication modules, industrial ethernet products, and network management product lines. The company also provides iSphir that delivers intelligent IT/OT security for critical infrastructure; qSphir, which secures national and critical infrastructures with quantum-safe technology; and subscription solutions under the Connamic name. In addition, it offers private 5G networks, network disaggregation, gigabit access and backhaul networks, and energy powering for FTTx networks and mobile 5G cells, as well as network management, engineering and supply, RF embedded engineering, and carbon capturing and bio-energy solutions. Further, the company provides professional services, such as service desk, monitoring, installation, troubleshooting, and storage and logistics support; project management and consulting; and connectivity and aggregation, software defined defense, network security and quantum protection, enterprise networking, software defined adaptive growth, GPON and XGS-PON SFP, utility network, critical infrastructure, and SHDSL network lifecycle extension solutions. The company was formerly known as UET United Electronic Technology AG and changed its name to aconnic AG in March 2024. aconnic AG was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany.

PREC.ST.longBusinessSummary: Precise Biometrics AB (publ) operates in the field of cybersecurity and biometric solutions in Sweden, Taiwan, China, the United States, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Digital Identity and Biometric Technologies. It offers Precise Access, a physical access management system based on biometrics, such as facial recognition; Precise Visit system for secure and efficient visitor management in companies; Precise BioMatch Automotive for identity authentication in cars and other automotive; and Precise BioMatch Smart Card for identity authentication in smart cards. The company also provides Precise BioMatch Mobile for identity authentication in smartphones and tablets; Precise BioLive, an anti-tampering and liveness product for preventing fraud and tampering using fake palm or fingerprints; Precise BioMatch Smart door lock for identity authentication door locks; Precise BioMatch Laptop for identity authentication in laptops; and BioEnhance for image enhancement. It offers its products to sensor manufacturers, systems integrators, and suppliers of applications. Precise Biometrics AB (publ) was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Lund, Sweden.

AXOLOT.ST.longBusinessSummary: Axolot Solutions Holding AB (publ) provides solutions for industrial water purification in Sweden. It offers AxoPur, a water purification system; and offers turnkey systems and solutions for water purification. The company also provides industries solutions, including smelting, chemical, and paper and pulp; coating, surface treatment, and metalworking; dairies, slaughterhouses, and fish farming/fish slaughterhouses; smaller treatment plant and leachate water from landfill; and stormwater, vacuum truck sludge water, leachate water, and vehicle wash. In addition, it provides consulting services. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Helsingborg, Sweden.

ALUPG.PA.longBusinessSummary: UPERGY Société Anonyme manufactures and distributes batteries in France, Europe, and internationally. It offers chargers; portable lighting; and solar solutions, as well as products related to security and housing. The company provides its products under the 1001 Piles Batteries, Allbatteries, Enix Energies, Enix Power Soltions, Hawk-Woods, GBS, and Microbatt brands. It distributes its products to professionals, individuals, small retailers, companies, and wholesalers. The company was formerly known as VDI Group Société Anonyme and changed its name to UPERGY Société Anonyme in June 2018. UPERGY Société Anonyme was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Limonest, France. UPERGY Société Anonyme operates as a subsidiary of Heler SA.

ACTI.ST.longBusinessSummary: Active Biotech AB (publ), a biotechnology company, engages in the research, development, production, marketing, and sale of medical, chemical, and biotechnology products in Sweden. It is developing Tasquinimod, a small molecule immunomodulator, which is in Phase II clinical trial to treat hematological malignancies; Laquinimod, an immunomodulator for the treatment of severe inflammatory eye diseases, such as non-infectious non anterior uveitis; and Naptumomab estafenatox, a tumor targeting immunotherapy to treat patients with solid tumors. The company has collaboration with Abramson Cancer Center, University of Pennsylvania, MD Anderson Cancer Center, Texas and Stictching-Haemato-Oncologie Volwassenen Netherlands, as well as Stanford Medicine and the Global Ophthalmic Research Center. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Lund, Sweden.

DEVP-B.ST.longBusinessSummary: DevPort AB (publ) operates as a technology consulting company in Sweden. It operates through three segments: Product Development, Production Development and Digital Solutions. The company offers product development, including construction, such as exterior and interior design, electrical system and wiring, chassis construction, powertrain, battery system, manufacturing tools, and measurement and test equipment; project management comprising development projects, testing and verification, product launch, and quality and rationalization; and testing and verification, which include individual components, system, complete product, and electrical architecture. DevPort AB (publ) was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden.

RAD.MI.longBusinessSummary: Radici Pietro Industries & Brands S.p.A. offers textile flooring for offices, residential, and commercial establishments; and professionals in the cruise, ferry, and yacht sectors worldwide. It develops and manufactures artificial turf for sports and landscape applications. The company also provides customizable textile accessories for vehicles, offering tailor-made solutions, as well as operates an e-commerce platform for rugs and artificial turf. It offers its products under the Radici Carpet, Radici Marine, Radici Sports, and Radici Automotive brands. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Cazzano Sant'Andrea, Italy. Radici Pietro Industries & Brands S.p.A. is a subsidiary of Miro Radici Family of Companies s.p.a.

MPT.MI.longBusinessSummary: Impianti S.P.A. operates as an infrastructural system integrator in the ICT field. It offers managed services, business development and system integrator, and sale outsourcing services. The company is headquartered in Carate Brianza, Italy.

ALNFL.PA.longBusinessSummary: NFL Biosciences SA, a biotechnology company, engages in the development of botanical drugs in France. The company's pipeline includes NFL-101, a drug candidate for smoking cessation, currently under CESTO II Phase 2 study; NFL-101, a drug candidate for smoking cessation; and NFL-301, a drug candidate for reducing alcohol consumption which is in preclinical stage. It has scientific collaboration with McLean Hospital to deepen the understanding of the mechanism of action of NFL-101, its proprietary botanical drug candidate for smoking cessation. NFL Biosciences SA was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Castelnau-le-Lez, France.

CLEM.ST.longBusinessSummary: Clemondo Group AB (publ), a chemical engineering company, develops, manufactures, and supplies cleaning and hygiene solutions for professional users in Sweden. The company offers disinfection, packaging and packaging handling, vehicle care accessories, chemical and waste management, kitchen and dishwashing hygiene, cleaning, personal hygiene, personal protective equipment, system and detail cleaners, system fluids, and laundry, as well as wastewater treatment plants, vehicles, and water treatment. It sells its products under its Strovels, Life, and Lahega brands. The company was formerly known as NC Lahega AB (publ) and changed its name to Clemondo Group AB (publ) in May 2017. Clemondo Group AB (publ) was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Helsingborg, Sweden.

PROAC.PA.longBusinessSummary: Proactis SA provides cloud-based spend management solutions in France, Germany, the United Kingdom, the Unites States, and internationally. It offers source-to-pay, supplier relationship management, contract management, procure-to-pay, sourcing, and accounts payable automation software, as well as AI and marketplace. The company also provides professional services; application managed service; training; support services; integration of ERP, financial, and other supply chain systems; and invoice capture managed service. It serves housing, property and facilities management, not-for-profit, financial services, transport and logistics, public services, care providers, education, and professional services sectors. The company was formerly known as Hubwoo and changed its name to Proactis SA in January 2019. Proactis SA was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Paris, France. The company operates as a subsidiary of Proactis Euro Hedgeco Limited.

BAWAT.ST.longBusinessSummary: Bawat Water Technologies AB, through its subsidiary, provides patented heat-based ballast water management system (BWMS) in Europe, Asia, and North America. The company offers ship based BWMS for new build and retrofit applications on ships; mobile BWMS for ports, terminals, shipyards, and service providers; and Ballast as a Service, a ballast water treatment solution. It also offers after-sales and maintenance services. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Horsholm, Denmark.

YIELD.ST.longBusinessSummary: SaveLend Group AB (publ), through its subsidiaries, operates as a fintech company in Sweden and Finland. It offers SaveLend, a savings platform that enables savers to earn returns through savings in credit, such as corporate, real estate, and consumer credit, as well as factoring. The company has strategic partnership with Nooga to implement Nooga Navigator, an AI-based platform for governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). SaveLend Group AB (publ) was founded in 2014 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

OODA.ST.longBusinessSummary: OODA AI AB (publ) focuses on artificial intelligence (AI) and software-as-a-service (SaaS) primarily in business intelligence and data security. It provides AI services in the form of decentralized and distributed AI computing and AI tools, as well as AI consulting, training, and implementation. The company was formerly known as oodash Group AB (publ) and changed its name to OODA AI AB (publ) in July 2025. OODA AI AB (publ) was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

TUF.DE.longBusinessSummary: LIBERO Football Finance AG provides working capital finance for football companies in Europe. It also offers professional services and business consulting for European professional football companies. The company was formerly known as RAVENO Capital AG and changed its name to LIBERO Football Finance AG in July 2023. LIBERO Football Finance AG was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, Germany.

NEO-B.ST.longBusinessSummary: Neovici Holding AB (publ) provides automated financial services through a software-as-a- (SaaS) service model. The company develops, sells, and implements a cloud-based platform for financial automation. It serves companies primarily in the retail, energy, and telco industries in Sweden and internationally. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

FASTPC.CO.longBusinessSummary: FastPassCorp A/S engages in developing software and SaaS solutions for protecting large organizations passwords and password processes in Denmark and internationally. It offers FastPass Suite, a user verification solution; FastPass IVM, an identity verification manager; FastPass SSPR, a self-service password reset software; and FastPass Sync, a password synchronization solution for multiple applications and systems. The company also provides FastPass MSP password reset solution and FastPass Cloud, a web-based active directory password reset self-service solution. It serves the healthcare, universities and education, financial services, and government industries. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark.

BOUL.ST.longBusinessSummary: Boule Diagnostics AB (publ) develops, manufactures, and markets instruments and consumable products for blood diagnostics in the United States of America, Asia, Eastern Europe, Latin America, Western Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. It operates through Diagnostics and OEM Clinical Diagnostic Solutions. The company provides hematology analyzers, reagents, controls, and calibrators, under the Swelab, and Medonic brands; and veterinary hematology and clinical chemistry analyzer systems, as well as reagents and panels under the Exigo brand. It serves small and medium-sized hospitals, clinics, laboratories, and veterinary clinics, and other diagnostics firms. The company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Spånga, Sweden.

PILA.ST.longBusinessSummary: Pila Pharma AB (publ) operates as a clinical stage biotech company in Sweden. The company develops XEN-D0501, a TRPV1 antagonist in Phase 2a trial for obesity, diabetes, and heart failure; Phase 1 trial for erythromelalgia, inflammation pain, and rare diseases; and preclinical trial for abdominal aorta aneurism and cardiovascular diseases. Pila Pharma AB (publ) was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Malmö, Sweden.

IDLDX.ST.longBusinessSummary: IDL Diagnostics AB (publ), a vitro diagnostics company, manufactures and sells IVD tests for oncological and bacterial diseases in Sweden. It offers UBC Rapid, a point-of-care test for diagnosis and monitoring of bladder cancer; AroCell TK 210 ELISA, a biomarker for tumor cells; and TUBEX TF, a vitro diagnostic test for detection of acute typhoid fever. Its vitro diagnostic biomarkers are used in breast, bladder, and prostate cancer therapies. The company was formerly known as AroCell AB (publ) and changed its name to IDL Diagnostics AB (publ) in May 2025. IDL Diagnostics AB (publ) was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

NOTEK.ST.longBusinessSummary: Norditek Group AB (publ) develops, sells, leases, or rents out crushers, sorting plants, and self-developed machines to recycle and convert materials in Sweden into salable products in Sweden. The company recycles industrial waste, wood waste, and gravel and rocks. It offers flip flow sieves, sorting plant, wind visibility, water bath, magnets, air suction, crushers, laundry equipment, semi-stationary plant, waste compactors, belt conveyor, stacker, screening media, and other accessories. Norditek Group AB (publ) was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden.

RKT.MI.longBusinessSummary: Rocket Sharing Company S.P.A. operates a marketplace of goods and services in Italy. It operates rocketsharing.it, a cashback platform based on blockchain technology that brings together supply and demand between companies and consumers, as well as recognizes cashback with every purchase; and shop.rocketsharing.it, an affiliate program at physical stores for participation in the shared loyalty circuit. The company also operates rocketenergy.it, a platform for electricity and gas supplies for business and residential segments; tbacademy.it, a Blockchain academy for individuals and companies with courses, consultancy, and solutions in the Blockchain, Fintech, NFT, and cryptocurrency areas; and danielevigano.com that offers training courses for personal and professional growth for individuals and companies. Rocket Sharing Company S.P.A. was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Milan, Italy.

PRE.MI.longBusinessSummary: Predict S.p.A. designs, develops, and sells medical diagnostic imaging systems in Italy. The company offers ultrasound for gynecology, cardiology, general imaging, and point of care; X-ray; and technical assistance. It also provides Mistral, a breath analysis diagnostic system; Optip, an integrated communication technology in remote that allows holopresence interaction for users by exchanging information content; and Aphel, a humanoid robot that assists patients and healthcare professionals in hospital. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Bari, Italy. Predict S.p.A. is a subsidiary of Qo3 S.r.l.

TRIBO-B.ST.longBusinessSummary: Tribox Group AB (publ), an environmental technology group, develops and markets lubricants and fuel additives in Sweden, rest of the Nordic countries, rest of Europe, Asia, Africa, and internationally. It offers engine, hydraulic, and transmission oils for the transport, construction, and forestry sectors; and additives that enable the use of bio-based fuels for the power generation, transportation, and marine industries. The company was formerly known as Triboron International AB (publ) and changed its name to Tribox Group AB (publ) in June 2025. Tribox Group AB (publ) was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Karlstad, Sweden.

MLSDN.PA.longBusinessSummary: La Savonnerie De Nyons manufactures and sells soaps and cosmetics in France. It also offers perfumed sachets, soap holders, magnets, and totes. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Nyons, France.

CHECK.ST.longBusinessSummary: Checkin.Com Group AB (publ) develops software as a service that allow its consumers to connect with brands and services online in Sweden and internationally. The company offers its software as an end-to-end solution for users to become customers online, and combines multiple UX-systems, data sources, and identity solutions to instantly configure individually adapted check-in experiences for each end user. It serves financial services, iGaming, travel and leisure, and other industries. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

TCM.MI.longBusinessSummary: Tecma Solutions S.p.A., a tech company, develops technology and digital content for real estate businesses. It provides a cloud software to control business development in real estate; hardware, such as digital desk, digital totem, digital dashboard, VR viewer, tablet, smart tv, and audio kits; IT infrastructure solutions, including architecture, cloud infrastructure, database, software design, user experience, user interface, code development, usability, and customer journey; store and showroom technology; security and compliance comprising data protection, money transfer protection, and software and infrastructure protection; and digital asset libraries. The company also offers digital platforms consisting of iTx digital design, iT1 go to market, iT3 digital real estate, iT4 asset revamping, and iT4 asset development. In addition, it provides content and technical services, such as art direction and marketing, virtual architecture, brand design and communication, digital marketing, photo and video, design and development, digital real estate finance, digital asset management, digital transformation, and digital project management services. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Milan, Italy.

ENERG.OL.longBusinessSummary: Energeia AS engages in the develops, manages, and owns solar power plants in Norway and the Netherlands. It installs, sells, and services energy equipment and systems. The company also operates solar power plant with an installed capacity of 12.1 megawatts in the Netherlands. Energeia AS was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.

XHS.MI.longName: Xenia Hôtellerie Solution S.p.A. Società Benefit
XHS.MI.longBusinessSummary: Xenia Hôtellerie Solution S.p.A. Società Benefit operates in the hospitality sector. The company is involved in crew accommodation, hotel distribution, travel management and data analysis, and forecasting; and transfers and hotel accommodation for crews of airlines, railways, and shipping lines. It operates its hotels and accommodation business under the PHI Hotels brand name. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Guardiagrele, Italy. Xenia Hôtellerie Solution S.p.A. Società Benefit is a subsidiary of Phi Srl.

KENH.ST.longBusinessSummary: Kentima Holding AB (publ) develops, manufactures, and sells software and hardware products for the automation and security sectors in Sweden. The company offers WideQuick HMI/SCADA software for creating graphical monitoring systems; WideQuick HMI panels and boxes; and industrial computers. It also provides Ethiris Video Management Software (VMS), a surveillance system; Ethiris Network Video Recorder (NVR), Network Video Client (NVC), and Network Video Panel (NVP) for professional video surveillance; Ethiris NVRN rack solutions; and WideQuick Physical Security Information Management (PSIM), a surveillance system used within security facilities. In addition, the company offers HMI/SCADA concepts, such as the WideQuick modular framework, WideQuick water and wastewater treatment, and WideQuick building management systems; industrial computers comprising OE panel PCs and box PCs for various industrial uses; industrial touch monitors; and security-as-a-service products consisting of Ethiris alarm central services Safe4 and SOS alarm, and Ethiris access services and VMS Universal. Further, it provides various training courses for WideQuick Basic, Script, Professional, and MOD Basic; and Ethiris Basic, Professional, and Script. The company's products are used in the manufacturing and process industries, and real estate automation for individual machines, as well as in airports, truck terminals, sports arenas, shopping malls, shops, railway stations, industrial and process facilities, schools, hospitals, and other public buildings. It sells its products through system integrators, OEM customers, and other retailers. Kentima Holding AB (publ) was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Staffanstorp, Sweden.

ALAGO.PA.longBusinessSummary: E-Pango SA operates as an electricity and gas supplier. It serves service providers, distribution chains, leisure centers, local communities, and collective housing managers. E-Pango SA was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

AUGR.PA.longBusinessSummary: Augros Cosmetic Packaging SA provides customized packaging solutions in France. The company offers decoration solutions for glass, plastic, and aluminum packaging materials. It serves perfume, cosmetic, and spirit industries. The company is based in Alençon, France. Augros Cosmetic Packaging SA operates as a subsidiary of Famille Bourgine.

ABTEC.OL.longBusinessSummary: Aqua Bio Technology ASA, together with its subsidiary, develops and sells ingredients for skin care products in Norway. The company offers Aquabeautine XL, a proprietary ingredient for skincare products; and Spirulysat, an antioxidant and vitamin-boosted spirulina for cosmetic use. It also provides freight logistics solutions for trading companies. The company distributes its products through internet, stores, and skincare clinics. Aqua Bio Technology ASA was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.

ESG.CO.longBusinessSummary: Ennogie Solar Group A/S develops, manufactures, and sells building-integrated solar roofs and facades in Denmark and Germany. It also engages in battery solutions and installation business. Ennogie Solar Group A/S was founded in 1951 and is based in Herning, Denmark.

MLFTI.PA.longBusinessSummary: France Tourisme Immobilier SA engages in the real estate business in France. The company owns and manages real estate assets. The company was formerly known as France Design et Création. France Tourisme Immobilier SA was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Thyez, France. France Tourisme Immobilier SA is a subsidiary of FIPP S.A.

MLAZR.PA.longBusinessSummary: The Azur Selection S.A., a real estate investment company, invests, owns, operates, and manages hotels in Greece and the South of France. It also operates a shopping center, and a mixed use commercial property in Mykonos. The Azur Selection S.A. was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Voula, Greece.

C3R.DE.longBusinessSummary: Cherry SE, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells computer input devices in Germany. The company offers keyboards, mice, desktop sets, headsets, microphones, keyboard and desktop switches, and terminals; accessories, such as covers and mouse; and software and related services. It also provides e-health terminals and PIN pads for the healthcare sector. The company serves office and home office, gaming, healthcare, security, POS, and IOT sectors. It sells its products through distributors, resellers, system houses, retailers, and e-tailers. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany.

EPH.MI.longBusinessSummary: EPH Invest S.p.A. operates as an investment holding company in Italy. The company focuses on building a portfolio of shareholdings and creating value over the medium-to-long term by investing in small and medium-sized Italian and European enterprises. It acquires majority or qualified minority stakes and provides strategic support to its portfolio companies. The company was formerly known as E.P.H. S.p.A. and changed its name to EPH Invest S.p.A. in May 2026. EPH Invest S.p.A. is headquartered in Milan, Italy.

SPEONE.ST.longBusinessSummary: SpectrumOne AB (publ), a technology company, provides an advanced data management, analytics, and communications platform suite in Sweden, Norway, Finland, and Belgium. The company offers SaaS products comprising Prism Analytics, a big data management platform for business users; and Prism Cloud, a commercial insights and performance platform. It also develops advanced solutions for data collection, data processing, analysis, and artificial intelligence. In addition, the company offers SaaS online services; consulting for development services; and implementation and support services. The company was formerly known as TargetEveryone AB (publ) and changed its name to SpectrumOne AB (publ) in March 2020. SpectrumOne AB (publ) was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

NFGAB.ST.longBusinessSummary: Nordic Flanges Group AB (publ) manufactures and sells industrial flanges in Sweden, the rest of the Nordic region, the United States, and internationally. The company provides flanges in stainless steel, carbon steel, special alloys, titanium, and aluminum. It also manufactures collars, as well as welding rings and loose flanges. The company was formerly known as Vinovo AB (publ) and changed its name to Nordic Flanges Group AB (publ) in March 2015. Nordic Flanges Group AB (publ) was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Själevad, Sweden.

GCOM.MI.longBusinessSummary: Giglio.com S.p.A. engages in the online retail sale of multi-brand clothing in Italy, other European Union, and internationally. The company offers clothing, bags, shoes, accessories, and other products for women, men, and kids. It also provides lighting, home décor, tableware, bedding, bath linens, high tech, and leisure products. Giglio.com S.p.A. was founded in 1965 and is based in Palermo, Italy.

POLAR.OL.longBusinessSummary: Polar Resources AS operates as a natural resources company with focus on oil and gas and mineral mining. It holds four exploration licences covering areas with potential for copper and zinc deposits in central Norway. The company also focuses on acquisitions of oil and gas assets in Europe, Latin America and South-East Asia. The company was formerly known as Polar Transition Minerals AS and changed its name to Polar Resources AS in June 2026. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Oslo, Norway.

DGR.DE.longBusinessSummary: Deutsche Grundstücksauktionen AG provides real estate auction services in Germany. The company is involved in auctioning of third-party lands and rights equivalent to real estate on behalf of private, commercial, and public owners, as well as conducting auctions online. It also engages in the real estate brokerage business. The company was formerly known as Berliner Grundstücksauktionen-Organisationsgesellschaft mbH & Co KG and changed its name to Deutsche Grundstücksauktionen AG in 1998. Deutsche Grundstücksauktionen AG was founded in 1984 and is based in Berlin, Germany.

PVA.MC.longBusinessSummary: Pescanova, S.A. through its subsidiaries, engages in the production, transformation, distribution, and commercialization of seafood. The company was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Redondela, Spain.

ABS.OL.longBusinessSummary: Arctic Bioscience AS, a clinical-stage biotechnology company, engages in developing and commercializing pharmaceutical and nutraceutical ingredients based on bioactive marine compounds in Norway, the United States, Europe, and Asia Pacific. The company is developing HRO350, a novel oral drug which is in phase IIb for the treatment of mild-to-moderate psoriasis; and the HeROPA study, an international phase IIb clinical trial. It also sells nutraceuticals as an intermediary and finished goods products under the ROMEGA brand name. Arctic Bioscience AS was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Ørsta, Norway.

ALDBL.PA.longBusinessSummary: Bernard Loiseau S.A. engages in fine dining and hospitality businesses in France. The company operates its hotels, restaurants, and spas under the Le Relais Bernard Loiseau, La Tour d'Auxois, Loiseau des Vignes, Loiseau des Ducs*, Loiseau du Temps, Loiseau de Lorraine, Loiseau de France, and Loiseau la Patisserie names. Bernard Loiseau S.A. was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Saulieu, France.

FOU.BR.longBusinessSummary: Fountain S.A. provides machines for cold and hot drinks made from freeze-dried or grain products in France, Belgium, the Netherlands, rest of European Countries, and internationally. The company provides coffee and cartridge machines, other beverages machines, and water fountains, as well as repair and refurbishment service. It also offers furniture and accessories for coffee break areas. The company offers its products through independent distributors. Fountain S.A. was founded in 1972 and is based in Braine l'Alleud, Belgium.

ACE.ST.longBusinessSummary: Ascelia Pharma AB (publ), a biotech company, develops identifies, develops, and commercializes novel drugs to treat orphan oncology treatments in Sweden. It develops Orviglance, a novel non-gadolinium diagnostic drug, which is in Phase 3 clinical trial for use in MRI-scans of the liver; and Oncoral, a novel oral irinotecan chemotherapy tablet, that is in Phase 2 clinical trial for the treatment of gastric cancer. The company has a collaboration agreement with the Taiho Oncology Inc. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Malmö, Sweden.

NACON.PA.longBusinessSummary: Nacon S.A., together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, and markets video game accessories in France and internationally. The company offers console controllers under the NACON brand; video game accessories for racing under the Revosim brand; and gaming headsets, microphones, and in-ear gaming earbuds under the RIG brand. It also develops, publishes, and distributes video games in various categories, such as action and adventure, racing, sport, and simulation. The company exports its products to the British Isles, Germany, Italy, Belgium, Spain, rest of Europe, North America, Asia, and Africa. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Fretin, France. Nacon S.A. is a subsidiary of BigBen Interactive.

GIGA.ST.longBusinessSummary: Gigasun AB (publ), engages in the financing, owning, and operating roof-mounted solar energy installations in China. The company installed a total of 404 MW of solar energy installations. It serves private and public organizations. The company was formerly known as Advanced Soltech Sweden AB (publ) and changed its name to Gigasun AB (publ) in February 2024. Gigasun AB (publ) was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

GRAL.MI.longBusinessSummary: Grifal S.p.A. provides packaging solutions in Italy, rest of Europe, and internationally. It offers corrugated cardboard packaging; cushion paper packaging, including cushion paper wrap, thermal, bottles, boxes, profiles, strips, tissue pack, and roll up products; and protective packaging solutions under the cArtù and Mondaplen brand names. Grifal S.p.A. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Cologno al Serio, Italy. Grifal S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of G-Quattronove S.R.L.

MLLCB.PA.longBusinessSummary: Les Constructeurs du Bois S.A. designs and constructs timber buildings in France. It operates through four segments: Eco-Neighborhoods, Medical Centers, Senior Residences, and Micro-Nurseries. The company designs and develops wooden real estate projects in the Grand Est region. It also develops serviced apartments for independent seniors, as well as offers various construction services. Les Constructeurs du Bois S.A. was founded in 2010 and is based in Épinal, France.

ALCOI.PA.longBusinessSummary: Coil S.A./N.V. provides anodizing services on aluminum flat rolled products in coil form, sheets, and panels in Europe. Its products are used in architectural, public works, welded tubes, automotive, consumer goods, medical, aerospace, and signage applications. The company offers its products under the ALOXIDE, X-ICONIC, X-WALL, X-BOND, X-FLEX, X-DECO, X-TECH, X-TREAD, X-3D, X-MED, and X-SKY brand names. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Landen, Belgium.

YOLO.MI.longBusinessSummary: Yolo Group S.p.A. provides digital insurance services to the individuals and small and medium-sized enterprises in Italy and internationally. It offers sport, pet, home and family, health, travel, mobility, and cars for private individuals; and multi-risk, legal protection, professional liability, photovoltaic and cyber insurance products for companies. The company also operates an Insurtech platform for companies to manage their insurance products. It also offers insurance solutions for partners and intermediates. Yolo Group S.p.A. was founded in 2017 and is based in Milan, Italy.

FPG.PA.longBusinessSummary: Union Technologies Informatique Group S.A., a digital service company, provides consulting and engineering services to banking, finance, insurance, retirement, industry, and service sectors in France and internationally. The company offers technical assistance, project management assistance, and IT engineering services. It also publishes and distributes application software packages for the publishing and cleaning sectors. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Levallois-perret, France. Union Technologies Informatique Group S.A. is a subsidiary of EEKEM GROUP.

ALKLK.PA.longBusinessSummary: Kerlink SA provides network infrastructure solutions for the Internet of Things (IoT) market to historical and alternative operators, businesses, and utilities in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, and the Americas. It offers Wirnet iZeptoCell, a LoRaWAN gateway that supports low-power wide-area networks (LPWA); Wirnet iFemtoCell-evolution for indoor coverage; Wirnet iFemtoCell, a LoRaWAN gateway for enterprise-grade indoor IoT use cases; Wirnet iStation, a LoRaWAN gateway for outdoor deployments; Wirnet iBTS LoRaWAN gateway, a power outdoor LPWA IoT networks; and Wirnet iBTS 64 Highway, a carrier-grade full-duplex outdoor LoRaWAN gateway. The company also provides edge computing solutions for embedded chirpstack and Things Park All in One; and LoRaWAN, a global standard for LPWA IoT networks. In addition, it offers maintain and operate related IoT services, as well as zero touch provisioning and embedded solutions; and Track Value, a solution for logistics. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Thorigné-Fouillard, France.

MLEDR.PA.longBusinessSummary: Compagnie des Eaux de Royan engages in the drinking water and related services in France. It also provides waste water sanitation services. Compagnie des Eaux de Royan was incorporated in 1955 and is based in Vaux-sur-Mer, France.

GIS.MI.longBusinessSummary: Gismondi 1754 S.p.A. produces and sells jewelry in Italy, Europe, and internationally. It offers rings, necklaces, earrings, and bracelets. The company was founded in 1754 and is based in Genoa, Italy.

ANNX.ST.longBusinessSummary: Annexin Pharmaceuticals AB (publ), a clinical stage biotechnology company, develops drug candidates for the treatment of various cardiovascular diseases. It develops ANXV, a human recombinant protein and Annexin A5, natural protein that protects and repairs cells, as well as counteract unwanted inflammatory and immune cell reactions that is in phase 2 clinical phase for the treatment of ophthalmology, oncology, sickle cell disease, and cardiovascular disease. Annexin Pharmaceuticals AB (publ) was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

IS7.DE.longBusinessSummary: InTiCa Systems SE develops, produces, and markets inductive components and systems, passive analog circuit technology, and mechatronic assemblies in Germany and internationally. It operates in two segments: Automotive, and Industry & Infrastructure. The company offers inverters, charging systems, and network switches, as well as EMC filters, actuators, stators, and sensors. It also provides toroidal transformers, 1-phase transformers, 3-phase transformers, print transformers, HF transformers, and special transformers; 1-phase chokes, 3-phase chokes, HF chokes, and toroidal chokes. In addition, the company offers electric machines and machines parts, such as stator coils, stators, and rotor; and plastic products. Further, it provides engineering, simulation, and prototyping services. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Passau, Germany.

ALOPM.PA.longBusinessSummary: Oncodesign Precision Medicine Société anonyme, a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the precision medicine business. The company's product pipeline consist of OPM-101, a RIPK2 inhibitor for the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease and immuno-oncology; OPM-102 to treat cancer; and OPM-201, a LRRK2 inhibitor for the treatment of Parkinson's disease. It also focuses on the development of a radiotheranostic molecule portfolio for the diagnosis and the treatment of advanced digestive cancers under PROMETHE brand; Nanocyclix, a kinase inhibitors, as well as on developing treatment for pancreatic and other cancers. Oncodesign Precision Medicine Société anonyme was founded in 1995 and is based in Dijon, France.

ALDUX.PA.longBusinessSummary: AdUX SA provides advertising services in France, Belgium, Italy, Spain, Germany, and the Netherlands. It provides non-intrusive advertising, in-content advertising, and geo marketing services. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

ALOKW.PA.longBusinessSummary: Groupe OKwind Société anonyme designs, manufactures, sells, and installs green energy management solutions in France. The company offers solar trackers, battery storage solution, and energy monitoring software. Groupe OKwind Société anonyme was founded in 2009 and is based in Torcé, France.

DADC.CO.longName: Danish Aerospace and Defence Company A/S
DADC.CO.longBusinessSummary: Danish Aerospace and Defence Company A/S designs, develops, manufactures, and sells medical monitoring and exercise equipment. It offers agile data analyzer and monitor, a medical software that supports loading data over a network connection; portable pulmonary function systems for use in the areas of respiratory, cardiovascular, and metabolic physiology; cycle ergometer with vibration isolation and stabilization system, a recumbent bicycle that provides aerobic exercise for the harmful physiological effects of exposure to microgravity; advanced respiratory monitoring systems; European enhanced exploration exercise devices; shuttle ergometer; and flight ergometer, the next generation space ergometer. The company provides respiratory monitoring systems-II equipment, a photo- and magnetoacoustic multi-gas analyzer for performing non-invasive cardiovascular and pulmonary measurements; and European gas delivery system, a specially developed gas cylinder used for calibration and measurement of equipment and/or as breathing gases for use in space. The company was formerly known as Danish Aerospace Company A/S and changed its name to Danish Aerospace and Defence Company A/S in May 2026. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Odense, Denmark.

CBB.MI.longBusinessSummary: CleanBnB S.p.A. develops, produces, and manages software and data management solutions for real estate management sector. The company manages apartments and holiday homes for short-term rentals. Its services include reservation, property, guest, and bureaucratic management, as well as cleaning and linen management services. CleanBnB S.p.A. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Milan, Italy.

ALEO2.PA.longBusinessSummary: Eo2 Société Anonyme designs, produces, and distributes wood heating products under the EO2 and PIKS brands in France. The company offers wood pellets, distri'pellets, densified wood logs, and bulk wood pellets. It also provides energy services, including installation, financing, and maintenance of the boiler and ancillary equipment. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Malakoff, France.

QINTER.CO.longBusinessSummary: Q-Interline A/S, an engineering company, develops solutions for process optimization and quality based on infrared spectroscopy and correct sampling in Denmark and internationally. The company offers quant analysers, a quant FT NIR analyser; DairyQuant GO, a laboratory milk analyser; InSight Pro, an in-line process analysis solution for production optimization; quant sampling accessories, comprising cup, bottle, petri, spiral, pivette, bag, and vial samplers; support agreements; and AnalyticTrust, a cloud-based surveillance tool to secure analyser performance. It also provides InfraQuant, a software platform used to streamline QC operations and produce analytical results; InSightView, a frontend software to monitor and control the daily operation of the InSight Pro analyser; and proficiency tests for data referencing and comparison. It serves dairy, plant-based beverages, agricultural, food and ingredients, chemical, and pharmaceutical industries. Q-Interline A/S was founded in 1996 and is based in Tølløse, Denmark.

FIRST-B.ST.shortName: First Venture Sweden AB ser. B
FIRST-B.ST.longBusinessSummary: First Venture Sweden AB (publ) is a private equity and venture capital firm specializes in middle market, turnaround, seed/startup, early venture, mid venture, late venture, bridge financing and growth capital investments. The firm focuses on the technology, health, and sustainability businesses in Sweden. The firm prefers to invest between $0.1 million to $5 million in equity per transaction having maximum enterprise value upto $50 million. It prefer to take minority stake. First Venture Sweden AB (publ) was founded in 2006 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

NOM.OL.longBusinessSummary: Nordic Mining ASA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, extraction, and production of minerals and metals in Norway. The company explores for rutile, almandine garnet, hydrothermal quartz vein, and titanium sponge deposits. Its flagship property is the 100% owned Engebø Rutile and Garnet project located in the Sunnfjord, Vestland, Norway. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Oslo, Norway.

SFL.ST.longBusinessSummary: Safello Group AB (publ) provides a brokerage platform for individuals and businesses. The company provides property, casualty, life, accident, and health insurance and reinsurance; operates railroad systems in North America; generates, transmits, stores, and distributes electricity from natural gas, coal, wind, solar, hydroelectric, nuclear, and geothermal sources; operates natural gas distribution and storage facilities, interstate pipelines, liquefied natural gas facilities, and compressor and meter stations; and holds interest in coal mining assets. It manufactures boxed chocolates and other confectionery products; specialty chemicals, metal cutting tools, and components for aerospace and power generation applications; prefabricated and site-built residential homes, flooring products; insulation, roofing, and engineered products; building and engineered components; paints and coatings; and bricks and masonry products, as well as offers manufactured and site-built home construction, and related lending and financial services. In addition, the company provides recreational vehicles, apparel, footwear, toys, jewelry, custom picture framing products, alkaline batteries, logistics services, and professional aviation training and shared aircraft ownership programs; castings, forgings, fasteners/fastener systems, aerostructures, and precision components; and cobalt, nickel, and titanium alloys. Further, it distributes televisions and information, and grocery and non-food consumer products; franchises and services quick service restaurants; and distributes electronic components. Additionally, it retails automobiles; furniture, bedding, and accessories; household appliances, electronics, and floor coverings; watches, home decor and repair services; sells kitchenware; and motorcycle clothing and equipment. The company operates through four divisions: Device eXperience (DX), Device Solutions (DS), SDC, and Harman. The company offers smartphones, tablets, audio sounds, watches, switches, and accessories; TVs, and sound devices; appliances, including refrigerators, washing machines and dryers, vacuum cleaners, cooking appliances, dishwashers, air conditioners, and air purifiers; monitors and memory storage products; displays, and smart and LED signages; and other accessories. It also engages in venture capital investments, cloud services, network devices installation, semiconductor equipment services, digital advertising platforms, marketing, consulting, connected services provider, logistics, financing, and software design activities. In addition, the company provides toll processing and sales of semiconductors and display panels; development and sale of network solutions; manufacture of semiconductors and food; the provision of repair services for electronic devices; and development and supply of semiconductor process defect and quality control software, as well as digital televisions, foundry, system large scale integration (LSI). Further, it provides connected car systems, audio and visual products, enterprise automation solutions, and connected services. The company operates an industrial space. Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Suwon-si, South Korea.

0Q1F.L.longBusinessSummary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. operates as a bank and financial holding company in the United States, rest of North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, Latin America, and the Caribbean. It operates in three segments: Consumer & Community Banking, Commercial & Investment Bank, and Asset & Wealth Management. The company offers deposit, investment and lending products, and cash management; mortgage origination and servicing activities; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and credit cards, payment solutions, travel services, merchant offers, lifestyle benefits, auto loans, and leases to consumers and small businesses through bank branches, ATMs, and digital and telephone banking. 0R1W.L.longBusinessSummary: Walmart Inc. engages in the operation of retail and wholesale stores and clubs, ecommerce websites, and mobile applications worldwide. Further, the company offers consumer electronics and accessories, software, video games, office supplies, appliances, and third-party gift cards. Additionally, it operates digital payment platforms; offers financial services and related products, including money transfers, bill payments, money orders, check cashing, prepaid access, co-branded credit cards, installment lending, and earned wage access; and markets lines of merchandise under private and licensed brands. 0R1M.L.longBusinessSummary: ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation engages in the exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas in the United States, Canada, and internationally. The Specialty Products segment offers finished lubricants, basestocks, waxes, synthetics, elastomers, and resins. In addition, the company offers aviation fuel. It sells its products under the Exxon, Esso, and Mobil brands. The company was formerly known as Exxon Mobil Corporation and changed its name to ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation in July 2026. ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Spring, Texas.

0QZ0.L.longBusinessSummary: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. The company was founded in 1886 and is based in New Brunswick, New Jersey.

0R0K.L.longBusinessSummary: Cisco Systems, Inc. designs, develops, and sells technologies to power, help, secure, and draw insights from the internet in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, Japan, and China. 0R2Q.L.longBusinessSummary: Chevron Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the integrated energy and chemicals operations. It operates through Upstream and Downstream segments. The Downstream segment refines crude oil into petroleum products; markets crude oil, refined products, and lubricants; manufactures and markets renewable fuels; transports crude oil and refined products through pipeline, marine vessel, motor equipment, and rail car; and manufactures and markets commodity petrochemicals, plastics for industrial uses, and fuel and lubricant additives. 0Q16.L.longBusinessSummary: Bank of America Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services for individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses, institutional investors, large corporations, and governments worldwide. The Consumer Banking segment offers traditional and money market savings accounts, certificates of deposit and IRAs, checking accounts, and investment accounts and products; credit and debit cards; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and direct and indirect loans. The GWIM segment provides investment management, brokerage, banking, and trust and retirement products and services; wealth management solutions; and customized solutions, including specialty asset management services. The Global Banking segment offers lending products and services, including commercial loans, leases, commitment facilities, trade finance, and commercial real estate and asset-based lending; treasury solutions, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment provides market-making, financing, securities clearing, settlement, and custody services; securities and derivative products; and risk management products using interest rate, equity, credit, currency and commodity derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed-income, and mortgage-related products. 0R1G.L.longBusinessSummary: The Home Depot, Inc. operates as a home improvement retailer in the United States and internationally.
